title: Sustainability Program Manager
description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About This Role:

  • As a Sustainability Program Manager, you will be an important member of Crusoe's sustainability team, transforming sustainability commitments into day-to-day operational reality. You will own the processes, training, and tracking that make our sustainability KPIs achievable and enforceable across a rapidly expanding portfolio of AI data centers and energy assets. You’ll work directly with cross-functional teams to translate targets into requirements, workflows, and accountability at the site and project level. This role suits someone with technical fluency in how manufacturing facilities and data centers are built and run, who is energized by designing scalable processes, driving adoption, and closing the gap between commitment and performance.

What You’ll Be Working On:

  • Lead operational sustainability initiatives related to water, waste, and carbon, from scoping through delivery, building project plans, aligning stakeholders, tracking milestones, and surfacing risks early.

  • Support sustainability implementation throughout the lifecycle of data center projects by helping to define, monitor, and improve data center construction and operational efficiency metrics, including embodied carbon, waste diversion, PUE, and WUE. Partner with internal teams and external partners to identify performance gaps and drive improvements.

  • Design and implement the processes, SOPs, and checklists that embed sustainability requirements into manufacturing, construction, commissioning, and site operations, and train site teams, contractors, and partners to apply them consistently.

  • Support green building certification strategies (e.g., LEED, Green Globes) across new builds, coordinating documentation, consultants, and design team inputs.

  • Build and maintain dashboards, trackers, and automated workflows that give teams timely visibility into operational performance, using AI-enabled tools to reduce manual effort.

  • Manage renewable energy tracking and energy performance data, working with Energy, Finance, and Operations teams to monitor portfolio status and surface risks and opportunities.

  • Provide as-needed support across the broader sustainability team, flexing into emerging priorities, ad-hoc data requests, and new initiatives as the business evolves.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering, environmental science, sustainability, data analytics, or a related field. Candidates from other backgrounds with demonstrated technical depth are encouraged to apply.

  • Experience: 4-7 years of professional experience in sustainability operations, construction or energy management, supply chain or supplier management, or environmental consulting, ideally within the data center, cloud infrastructure, energy, or technology sectors. This should include hands-on management of operational programs, performance metrics, or compliance and enforcement processes.

  • Data Center & Energy Knowledge: Strong understanding of data center construction and operations, including metrics (PUE, WUE, CUE) and power, cooling, and energy systems. Familiarity with renewable energy instruments and energy markets.

  • Program Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, manage competing priorities, and influence stakeholders.

  • Process Design: Proven ability to design, document, and roll out scalable processes, SOPs, and controls across many stakeholders and sites, and to drive adoption and adherence.

  • Supply Chain & Vendor Engagement: Experience engaging suppliers, contractors, or vendors to set requirements, build capability, and hold them accountable to performance expectations, including through contract terms, scorecards, and corrective action.

  • Technical & Analytical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Excel and strong data skills, such as SQL, Python, or BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker). Experience building trackers, dashboards, and data quality controls.

  • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex sustainability data into clear narratives for diverse stakeholders.

  • Adaptability & Ownership: Self-starter who exercises sound judgment under ambiguity, proactively surfaces risks and opportunities, and takes full ownership of outcomes in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Bonus Points:

  • Familiarity with green building certifications (LEED AP, Green Globes) or embodied carbon in construction, including whole building LCA tools (e.g., EC3, One Click LCA, Tally).

  • Experience running supplier engagement or responsible sourcing programs, such as supplier scorecards, audits, or sustainability requirements in procurement.

  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini) to build trackers, automate workflows, or improve efficiency.

  • Experience with construction project management, contractor compliance programs, or EHS/quality management systems.

Benefits:

  • Industry competitive pay

  • Restricted Stock Units in a fast growing, well-funded technology company

  • Health insurance package options that include HDHP and PPO, vision, and dental for you and your dependents

  • Employer contributions to HSA accounts

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Teladoc

  • 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4% of salary

  • Generous paid time off and holiday schedule

  • Cell phone reimbursement

  • Tuition reimbursement

  • Subscription to the Calm app

  • MetLife Legal

  • Company paid commuter benefit; $300 per month

Compensation:

Compensation will be paid in the range of $115,000 - $140,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

title: Night Shift EMT Operations Supervisor
description:
The Operations Supervisor is responsible to be able to fill the role as a Emergency Vehicle Operators (EVOs) first and foremost, and is responsible for ensuring field operations teams conduct daily operations in a manner that provides excellent customer service, follows all safety procedures and policies, and maintains compliance with all federal, state, and local requirements and regulatory/licensing agencies. The Operations Supervisor will ensure that team members have all the necessary equipment, resources, licensing/credentials, and training to complete their patient care and assigned transports in a proper and efficient manner that meets our contractual and customer service standards, and that crews and vehicles are compliant with all local, state, and federal regulations.

The Operations Supervisor will be entrusted with a split role, with 40% of their role being direct supervision and the first line of contact for not only EVOs but also the CMH clinical crews to ensure the fleet is always operationally ready. If deficiencies are found, the Operations Supervisor will ensure that there is a plan of action in place to rectify them as soon as possible, and that the plan has been effectively communicated to all stake holders.


ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

· Provide excellent patient care within the scope of practice of an EMT EVO

· Provide Leadership & Oversight to all EVO’s

· Work as the Liaison with Leadership, to advance the program

· Provide leadership and guidance to team members through communicating company initiatives, addressing, and resolving concerns, and providing all tools and resources needed to complete assignments in an efficient manner.

· Motivate, mentor and coach your team to ensure customer service, safety, and compliance standards are met. Effectively address issues or concerns promptly and use critical thinking skills to remove barriers or obstacles to achieving company goals.

· Address gaps in scheduling immediately and work with the BMT management team to use all available resource to resolve schedule gaps, ensuring there is never a gap in coverage for an EVO. Supervisors should be prepared to fill open shifts or gaps in coverage if needed at the last minute.

· Respond, investigate, and determine the root cause of vehicle accidents, employee injuries or other liability concerns to reduce and eliminate hazardous work conditions and reduce total company liabilities.

· Review late punches, and remediate crews on policies regarding lateness, and then begin progressive disciplinary process.

· Complete Employee FIT Tests

· Serve as a Field Training Officer to New Employees

· Provide safe transport of the patient and crew

· Respond to emergent and non-emergent transports

· Provides effective communication with patients, dispatch, crews, family members, and facility staff

· Ability operation communication devices; portable radio, cell phone, computer tablet

· Ensure maintenance of vehicles and equipment for transport readiness

· Review Samsara AI Cammera’s & Complete Safety Retraining as needed

· Coordinate With Fleet Management to Rotate Trucks as Needed

· Respond to CNH Trouble Tickets Timely

· Maintain cleanliness of station

· Maintain certifications with timely completion of refresher courses and CMEs

· Remain current on all state protocols, policies, and/or procedures

· Represent BMT at community events as assigned


QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS

· Graduation From High School or equivalent

· Must be at least 19 years old or older at time of hire for insurance purposes

· Current NREMT and State EMT (or ability to obtain within 10 days of hire)

· Obtain DC affiliation of EMT B through Butler Medical Transport within 30 days of hire

· Two years of EMT experience · Two years of EVO experience

· Must successfully complete the CNH EVO Orientation Program

· Valid driver’s license

· Ability to drive company vehicles with a clean driving record

· Successful completion of a state sponsored EVOS course or ability to obtain in 30 days

· Current AHA BLS CPR or ability to obtain within 10 days of hire

· Successful DC affiliation through Butler Medical Transport within 30 days of hire

· Successful completion of GEMS, NRP, and STABLE within 180 days of hire

· Ability to provide quality patient care within scope of practice

· Knowledge of all state protocols for an EMT

· Availability for recall in times of crisis

· Ability to work a rotating schedule with open availability

· Ability to pass a lift test of 150 – 200 pounds

· Ability to pass a pre-employment drug test

· Ability to pass a pre-employment background check

· Ability to speak and write English


PREFERRED SKILLS

· Excellent customer service skills

· Knowledge of medical terminology and writing patient care reports

· Problem solving

· Ability to remain calm under pressure

· Previous leadership experience preferred


We'd love to have you join the Butler Medical Transport team!

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
You may know Penske for our big yellow trucks. But did you know we’re an industry-leading technology innovation company? At Penske we have a 50-year history of leading the transportation and supply-chain industry, delivering world-class and award-winning technology solutions. And, it starts with our associates. No matter what your skills or technology stack, our IT team is for you. You’ll work and grow alongside great people and on really cool projects. We inspire our IT experts to push the boundaries, create possibilities, be innovative, and, most of all, to have fun. Ultimately, you’ll help develop and ensure our technology solutions keep our company and our customers moving forward. Do you have what IT takes?


Summary

The Salesforce Developer is responsible for designing, developing, configuring, testing, deploying, and supporting Salesforce platform solutions that meet business and technical requirements. This role partners with business stakeholders, Salesforce administrators, internal IT teams, offshore development teams, Salesforce Support, and third-party AppExchange partners to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable Salesforce capabilities.

What You Will Be Doing

As a Salesforce Developer, you will be part of a team that develops our next-generation applications while enhancing and supporting our existing Salesforce ecosystem. You will take a leading technical role — working closely with business stakeholders, engineers, and architects to translate complex requirements into scalable technical designs, implement solutions, and troubleshoot issues as they arise. You will also guide junior developers, influence platform standards, and drive optimization efforts across the Salesforce environment.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary point of contact and lead support resource for multiple Salesforce modules/processes, resolving business user issues in a timely manner.
  • Translate complex business requirements into technical designs; develop and implement related components and modules on the Salesforce platform.
  • Lead requirements and solution design workshops with business stakeholders, providing analysis and solution design expertise aligned with current and future business needs.
  • Design, build, and deploy high-performance technical solutions on the Salesforce Lightning Platform, adhering to Salesforce best practices and standards.
  • Develop custom applications using both declarative tools (Workflows, Process Builder, Flow) and programmatic development (Apex, Visual Force Pages, Triggers, Lightning/LWC Components).
  • Architect and support integrations between Salesforce and third-party platforms and backend web services (REST/SOAP).
  • Organize, manage, and guide offshore Salesforce development teams in alignment with established standards, processes, and procedures.
  • Serve as a technical escalation point for a business team, advising on technical feasibility and implementation strategies.
  • Communicate project status and issues clearly to team members and stakeholders; collaborate with cross-functional and project teams.
  • Ensure solutions are sustainable and maintainable across implementation and ongoing use.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve bugs and open issues to ensure on-time delivery and smooth hand-offs.
  • Participate in and help guide agile development processes, including sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives.
Qualifications

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent years of software development experience.
  • 5+ years of overall technology experience, including 2+ years of hands-on experience with the Salesforce.com Platform (Apex, Visual Force, SOQL, Unit Testing).
  • Strong working knowledge of Workflows, Reports, Process Builder, Flow, and Triggers.
  • Strong working knowledge of web services (REST & SOAP, JSON & XML, etc.).
  • Proven experience with Lightning Components and Lightning Web Component (LWC) development.
  • 1–2 years of project management experience preferred
  • Experience directly interacting with business SMEs for requirements gathering, solution design, development, and deployment.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and guide junior and offshore developers.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodology.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; ability to work effectively both independently and in a team environment.
  • Salesforce certification (e.g., Platform Developer I or II) required
  • Regular, predictable, full attendance is an essential function of the job.

• Willingness to travel as necessary, work the required schedule, work at the specific location required, complete Penske employment application, submit to a background investigation (to include past employment, education, and criminal history) and drug screening are required.


EEO Statement

Penske is an Equal Opportunity Employer.


Physical Requirements:

  • The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • The associate must regularly lift and /or move up to 25lbs/12kg.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include Close vision, Distance vision, Peripheral vision, Depth perception and Ability to adjust focus.
  • While performing the duties of this Job, the associate is regularly required to stand; walk; sit and talk or hear. The associate is frequently required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms.
About Us

About Penske Truck Leasing/Transportation Solutions

Penske Truck Leasing/Transportation Solutions is a premier global transportation provider that delivers essential and innovative transportation, logistics and technology services to help companies and people move forward. With headquarters in Reading, PA, Penske and its associates are driven by a dedication to excellence and a commitment to customer success. Visit Go Penske to learn more.

title: VLA Algorithm Engineer – Simulation Data Generation & World Models
description:
Job Description:

About the Role

We're looking for a VLA Algorithm Engineer working at the intersection of robotics, simulation, and world models to help advance our embodied AI foundation models. You'll build and optimize robotic simulation environments, develop large-scale synthetic training data pipelines, and improve how models trained in simulation transfer to real-world robots.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys tackling challenging problems in robotics, reinforcement learning, imitation learning, and 3D vision, and wants to help build more capable, robust, and generalizable robotic systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Robotics Simulation: Build and optimize simulation environments for robotic tasks, including manipulation, navigation, mobile manipulation, and humanoid robotics.

  • Embodied AI Foundation Models: Contribute to the training and optimization of embodied AI foundation models, including pretraining on large-scale egocentric human video and real-world robot data.

  • Multimodal Learning: Design approaches for incorporating multimodal inputs, including force and tactile sensing, and develop, train, evaluate, and optimize models that integrate these signals.

  • Simulation & Evaluation Infrastructure: Improve simulation and evaluation pipelines to reduce the sim-to-real gap and enhance model stability, robustness, and generalization across real-world environments.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 1 year of relevant professional experience or research experience in robotics, simulation, system identification, reinforcement learning (RL), imitation learning (IL), world models, 3D vision, or a related field.

  • Experience with robotics simulation, robotic learning, or related algorithm development.

  • Strong understanding of at least one relevant research area, such as reinforcement learning, imitation learning, system identification, world models, or 3D computer vision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Simulation Platform Development: Hands-on experience developing or extending simulation platforms, with familiarity with the underlying architecture of tools such as NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Orbit, MuJoCo, PyBullet, or Genesis.

  • Large-Scale Synthetic Data Generation: Experience building synthetic datasets for robotics or computer vision, developing scalable data generation pipelines, or using diffusion models for large-scale synthetic data generation.

  • Sim-to-Real Transfer: Demonstrated experience transferring reinforcement learning or imitation learning policies from simulation to physical robotic arms or mobile robots. Familiarity with addressing simulation-to-reality differences in dynamics and observations through systematic compensation or adaptation techniques is a plus.

Default Benefits:

  • Health insurance

  • Vision care

  • Dental coverage

  • 401(k)

  • Paid holidays

  • PTO (Paid Time Off)

  • Sick leave

title: Senior Acquisition Program Manager
description:
Overview

SENIOR ACQUISITION PROGRAM MANAGER

LOCATION: Hanscom AFB, MA

SALARY RANGE: $145,000 - $155,000 annually*

*depending on experience, certifications, and qualifications

JOB STATUS: Full-time;salaried

CLEARANCE: Top Secret clearance required at time of hire

Astrion has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Acquisition Program Manager providing support to the Command, Control, Communications, and Battle Management Division (C3BM), which is located at Hanscom AFB, MA.

Command, Control, Communications, and Battle Management (C3BM) has been tasked with delivering an integrated Department of the Air Force (DAF) Battle Network providing resilient decision advantage and enabling the USAF, USSF, Joint, and Coalition Force to win against the pacing challenge. C3BM supports execution in many different focus areas. C3BM’s main efforts are Architecture and Systems Engineering (ASE), Operational Response Team (ORT), and multiple mission integration teams such as Air, Maritime, and multiple acquisitions consisting of both the Advanced Battle Management System (ABMS) and Space.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS / SKILLS

Must be a US citizen

Must have and be able to maintain a Top Secret Level Clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS / SKILLS

Education: Bachelor's or Master's Degree in a relevant professional discipline

Years of experience: 8 years of directly related experience with 5 years in a DoD setting

Technical Skills

  • Acquisition Program Management
  • DoDI 5000 Series Acquisition Processes
  • Cost, Schedule, and Performance Management
  • Program Risk Management
  • Acquisition Documentation Development and Review
  • Acquisition Reporting (DAES, MARs, APBs, SARs)
  • Source Selection Support
  • RFP, SOW, and CDRL Development
  • Program Integration and Contractor Management
  • Microsoft Office Suite

Interpersonal Skills

  • Proven leadership skills with the ability to lead multiple efforts simultaneously
  • Ability to work independently with minimal oversight
  • Strong mentoring and team development capabilities
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to develop and deliver executive-level briefings
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Government and contractor personnel
  • Ability to perform in a fast-paced, high-visibility environment

RESPONSIBILITIES

The Senior Program Manager will provide acquisition and program management support to Government Program Managers and Integrated Product Teams (IPTs) across the acquisition lifecycle. The position supports program execution activities involving cost, schedule, performance, risk management, acquisition documentation, milestone preparation, contractor coordination, and program reporting in support of Air Force acquisition programs.

Duties include, but not limited to:

  • Support Government Program Managers in executing acquisition programs in accordance with FAR, DoDI 5000.02, and applicable Air Force guidance and regulations
  • Plan, research, analyze, and assess acquisition projects to support cost, schedule, and performance objectives
  • Provide acquisition program management support to Program Managers and IPT Leads to maintain acquisition battle rhythm and deliver operational capability
  • Support development and review of acquisition documentation including Acquisition Strategies, APBs, LCSPs, Risk Management Plans, milestone briefings, and other program documentation
  • Assist with preparation and review of acquisition reports including DAES, MARs, APBs, SARs, and other statutory and regulatory documentation
  • Support program risk management activities including risk identification, analysis, handling, monitoring, and execution of risk management boards and working groups
  • Develop and support briefings, schedules, status reports, graphics, and acquisition documentation for senior leadership
  • Support source selection activities including development of evaluation criteria, RFP documentation, CDRLs, SOWs, and source selection support documentation
  • Review acquisition and program documentation to ensure consistency, completeness, and compliance with applicable guidance
  • Support implementation and execution of acquisition and development processes in coordination with Government and contractor personnel
  • Assist with program integration activities, contractor deliverable tracking, and schedule management
  • Support preparation and submission of funding documentation including Purchase Requests, MIPRs, and related acquisition documentation
  • Monitor and support interface control and coordination between program systems and stakeholders
  • Provide guidance on acquisition policies, procedures, and program management best practices
  • Support operational planning, capability development, event integration, analysis, and reporting activities
  • Maintain awareness of DoD acquisition reform initiatives and recommend process improvements where applicable

title: Sr. Network Engineer
description:
Business Unit Overview

Headquartered in Lakeville, Minn., Post Consumer Brands, a business unit of Post Holdings, Inc., is dedicated to providing people and their pets with delicious food choices for every taste and budget. The company's portfolio includes beloved brands such as Honey Bunches of Oats™, PEBBLES™, Grape-Nuts™ and Malt-O-Meal™ cereal and Peter Pan™ peanut butter, as well as Rachael Ray® Nutrish™, Kibbles 'n Bits™ and 9Lives™ dog and cat food. Post also provides private label solutions to customers in pet food, cereal, nut butters and granola. As a company committed to high standards of quality and to our values, we are driven by one idea: To make lives better by making delicious food accessible for all. For more information about our brands, visit and follow us on LinkedIn or Facebook for the latest news.


Location Description

Post Consumer Brands corporate headquarters in Lakeville, Minnesota, is about 20 miles south of Minneapolis and St. Paul, Lakeville has all the benefits of smaller town living with access to everything a large metropolitan area has to offer. Join more than 400 team members collaborating on the two-building campus to help put breakfast on the tables of millions of consumers in North America.


Responsibilities

Senior Network Engineer

As a Senior Network Engineer, you will design, build, secure, and support the enterprise network services that connect corporate offices, manufacturing facilities, distribution locations, data centers, cloud platforms, and third-party environments. You will bring hands-on expertise across LAN, WAN, wireless, firewalls, secure remote access, internet connectivity, cloud networking, and network monitoring.

Working across infrastructure, cybersecurity, applications, manufacturing/OT, and business teams, you will help deliver reliable, resilient, and secure connectivity. Your work will reduce recurring issues, strengthen network visibility, and support modernization, cloud adoption, site integrations, and technology refresh initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, implement, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise LAN, WAN, wireless, internet, VPN, and cloud connectivity.

• Support routers, switches, wireless infrastructure, firewalls, SD-WAN, secure web access, private application access, and Zero Trust Network Access technologies.

• Maintain network availability, performance, capacity, and resiliency across corporate, manufacturing, warehouse, data center, cloud, and third-party environments.

• Resolve complex routing, switching, latency, DNS, DHCP, wireless, firewall, and application communication issues; provide escalation support during incidents and outages.

• Implement network security controls with cybersecurity partners, including segmentation, firewall policies, secure remote connectivity, vulnerability remediation, and audit support.

• Develop scalable network designs, reference architectures, configuration standards, and technical recommendations based on security, supportability, performance, and cost.

• Partner with infrastructure, cloud, security, application, and manufacturing/OT teams on hybrid connectivity, site integrations, acquisitions, expansions, and technology refreshes.

• Use monitoring, analytics, telemetry, configuration management, and automation to improve reliability, consistency, reporting, deployment speed, and lifecycle management.

• Maintain network diagrams, inventories, configurations, IP addressing, circuits, operating procedures, and troubleshooting documentation.

• Coordinate with telecommunications carriers, managed service providers, hardware vendors, and project teams from planning and testing through transition to operations.

Why You’ll Love This Role

• Own high-impact network solutions that connect a diverse enterprise spanning offices, plants, distribution sites, data centers, and cloud environments.

• Help shape secure, modern connectivity through cloud networking, SD-WAN, Zero Trust, segmentation, automation, and observability.

• Work across technical and business teams where your expertise can improve reliability, simplify operations, and influence enterprise standards.

• Balance hands-on engineering and troubleshooting with architecture, modernization, and continuous improvement work.


Qualifications

Location Requirements:

  • Hybrid (2-3 days/week) at our Corporate Headquarters in Lakeville, MN.

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Required Qualifications

• 7+ years of enterprise network engineering or network administration experience.

• Strong knowledge of network segmentation, routing and switching, wireless networking, and network security concepts.

• Experience supporting enterprise switches, routers, wireless networks, and firewalls.

• Experience troubleshooting complex network, security, and application connectivity issues.

• Understanding of high availability, redundancy, disaster recovery, network resiliency, and capacity planning.

• Strong technical documentation and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Cisco networking technologies, Cisco Meraki, Palo Alto Networks firewalls, Zscaler, SD-WAN, Zero Trust networking, and Microsoft Azure networking.

• Experience with network monitoring and performance-management platforms, firewall policy management, or IT/OT segmentation in manufacturing environments.

• Experience automating network tasks with PowerShell, Python, APIs, infrastructure-as-code, or configuration-management tools.

• Relevant certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Microsoft Azure, or equivalent.

Success in This Role

• Approaches complex problems with strong analysis, structured troubleshooting, sound judgment, and a security-first mindset.

• Takes ownership, manages competing priorities, and follows through on incidents, projects, documentation, and continuous-improvement opportunities.

• Builds effective partnerships across infrastructure, cybersecurity, applications, manufacturing/OT, vendors, and business teams.

• Communicates technical concepts clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences and adapts as networking technologies evolve.

Ready to Make an Impact?

Bring your network engineering expertise to complex, business-critical environments where secure, reliable connectivity matters every day. Apply to help strengthen the platforms, standards, and partnerships that keep Post Consumer Brands connected and moving forward.

The pay range for this position is $106,019 - $156,909 per year.

title: Staff Data Engineer
description:
Role & Team

As a Staff Data Engineer at Overstory, you will lead the design and scaling of the data platform that enables Overstory’s AI-powered vegetation analysis. Our analysis depends on moving enormous volumes of satellite imagery, model inferences, and utility network data through orchestrated pipelines reliably, repeatably, and on time to support customer decision-making. You'll own the architecture of that platform and set the direction for how it evolves.

You'll work closely with data, ML, and product engineers, as well as product teams, to make sure the data flowing into our models and out to our customers balances pragmatic delivery with durability, traceability, and scalability. As a senior technical leader, you'll mentor other engineers, drive architectural decisions, and set standards for pipeline design, service boundaries, and data quality across Overstory.


Time zone requirement: Europe (GMT/WET, CET, EET) and Eastern North America (NST, AST, EST)

What You'll Do

In collaboration with data, ML, and product colleagues, you will:

  • Architect and evolve our orchestration layer — asset graphs, quality checks, partitioning strategies, and the patterns that keep it scaling reliably.

  • Design and maintain production data pipelines for large-scale geospatial and temporal data, from ingestion through transformation to delivery.

  • Lead system design work across the data platform, including service boundaries, data contracts, and designing around the failure modes that come with each.

  • Drive the shift toward a service-oriented architecture, decoupling tightly bound components into services that teams can own and deploy independently.

  • Build event-driven workflows, replacing brittle coupling and manual coordination with durable messaging patterns.

  • Establish observability, testing, and data quality frameworks so problems surface before customers see them, allowing any result to be traced back and explained.

  • Mentor engineers and define the standards for how we build, test, and operate data systems.

Skills & Experience

  • Experience thriving at the intersection of data engineering, distributed systems, and large-scale scientific data; deeply motivated by the opportunity to reduce wildfire risk and improve grid resilience through better data patterns and infrastructure

  • 10+ years of experience designing and building production-grade data pipelines and systems

  • Deep hands-on experience with Dagster — asset-based orchestration, partitions, sensors, and the operational side of running it in production (comparable experience with Airflow, Prefect, or similar is a reasonable substitute if you're ready to go deep on Dagster)

  • Proven track record building and operating data pipelines at scale, with a real feel for idempotency, backfills, and partitioning

  • Experience in preparing systems to handle periods of high demand with a focus on testability and scalability best practices

  • Strong system design skills — you can reason about boundaries, contracts, coupling, and failure modes, and explain the tradeoffs to people who'll use and build on them

  • Practical experience designing service-oriented architecture, including versioning and keeping things operational through migrations

  • Strong Python skills and experience with Google Cloud

  • Experience with Pub/Sub and event-driven patterns

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across engineering, ML, and product

  • Comfortable leading architectural discussions and mentoring other engineers

  • Experience in remote-first and globally distributed team

Nice To Have

  • Comfort working with geospatial data and the ways that it’s stored

  • Experience building data pipelines that power ML training and inference

  • Experience with analytics engineering tooling and warehouse modeling in BigQuery

  • Infrastructure-as-code experience and comfort owning your systems in production

  • Background in remote sensing, forestry, or the utility sector


Note: We believe that all people are capable of great things. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all of the requirements that are listed within this job description.

What We Offer

  • Competitive, location-specific compensation and benefits

  • Flexible, autonomous and collaborative working environment rooted in trust - we build our work days around our lives, not the other way around

  • Home office stipend, coworking and ongoing education budgets

  • A company culture that genuinely embodies each of our core values

  • To be part of truly mission-driven work that reduces wildfires, protects earth’s natural resources and helps solve our climate crisis

title: Director of Philanthropy
description:
Are you ready to make a difference in our community? At Jewish Community Services of South Florida (JCS), you’ll join a team of passionate professionals dedicated to making a positive impact in the lives of those we serve. Joining our team means contributing to a well-respected organization with over a century of service to the South Florida community, rooted in the values of compassion, inclusivity, and resilience. Our team members find purpose in empowering individuals and families through meaningful programs and initiatives. We foster a collaborative environment where your talents are valued, and you’ll have opportunities for personal and professional growth. If you’re looking to be part of an organization that values your contributions and promotes a culture of unity and support, JCS is the place to be.

Jewish Community Services of South Florida, Inc. (JCS) seeks a Director of Philanthropy to strengthen philanthropic support and cultivate meaningful relationships with key stakeholders. This position is instrumental in advancing the mission of JCS by securing financial resources and fostering donor engagement that supports programs for South Florida's diverse communities.

The Director will identify, cultivate, solicit, and steward donors contributing between $10,000 and $100,000+ annually. The person in this role will spearhead all JCS philanthropic initiatives, including but not limited to: re-design and implementation of annual solicitation strategies, future capital campaigns, and harnessing significant year over year philanthropic growth. Reporting to the CEO, the Director will lead philanthropic planning and serve as a key partner in achieving fundraising and engagement goals.

This is a full-time professional role requiring flexibility, including some evenings, weekends, and early mornings. As a representative of JCS, the Director is expected to uphold the organization’s values in all interactions.

Essential DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Responsibilities include the following, and other duties may be assigned:

  • Manage a portfolio of approximately 85+ high-level, major gift prospect donors, cultivating relationships and soliciting contributions between $10,000 and $100,000+
  • Achieve an annual fundraising goal of $1,000,000+
  • Create and implement data-driven annual fund strategies, identifying new donor prospects and increasing support from recurring donors and affinity groups
  • Department Fundraising Performance: Lead the Philanthropy team in achieving annual contributed-revenue goals established through the organization's annual development plan and budget
  • Major Gift Pipeline: Maintain a qualified major-gift pipeline sufficient to support current-year goals and future revenue growth, with measurable movement of prospects through identification, qualification, cultivation, solicitation and stewardship
  • Personal Revenue: Establish an annual individual fundraising goal based on the assigned portfolio, with emphasis on major gifts
  • Donor Retention: Achieve an agreed-upon annual retention target for donors within the Director's portfolio and oversee strategies designed to improve organization-wide donor retention
  • Donor Upgrades: Increase the number and/or percentage of existing donors who move into higher giving levels annually, by at least 10%, particularly donors transitioning into major-gift status
  • Team Performance: Establish individual fundraising goals, portfolios and performance expectations for philanthropy staff and conduct regular pipeline and portfolio reviews to ensure progress toward department goals
  • Forecasting: Maintain an accurate fundraising forecast and regularly report progress, pipeline health, risks and opportunities to the CEO and Board of Directors
  • Affinity Group Performance: Establish annual goals for affinity groups that measure fundraising, donor acquisition, retention, upgrades and meaningful engagement

SupervISION:

The Director will provide oversight and guidance to the Philanthropy Team.

PERKS: We are proud to offer a competitive benefits package to all full-time employees, including medical and dental plans. A generous vacation and holiday pay benefit and a 401(k) match is available. Staff receives monthly in-service training and CEU opportunities. This is a one of a kind opportunity for leadership in talent management to contribute to a team of mindful, caring and passionate people at work every day in service to our community!

ABOUT: Jewish Community Services of South Florida (JCS) is the foremost non-profit, human services agency whose mission is to improve the quality of life and self-sufficiency of the Jewish and broader communities throughout South Florida in accordance with Jewish values. Founded in 1920, JCS delivers exemplary social services through compassionate and comprehensive programs that help people stay healthy and productive.

JCS is a 501(c)(3) not-for-profit organization and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, disability, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, or veteran status.

JCS strictly enforces a Drug-Free Workplace Policy, which prohibits the use, possession, distribution, or sale of controlled substances and alcohol on company premises, during work hours, or while representing the company. Pre-employment and random drug testing may be required as part of our commitment to a drug-free workplace.

All Full-Time staff members are required to attend and work from start to end, JCS' Milk and Honey, Matzah Mitzvah and other similar events, which are typically held on Sundays and/or evenings. These events are essential to our organizational culture and participation is key to fostering team unity, supporting our values, and engaging with our community. By attending, it helps to set the standard for involvement and demonstrate our commitment to these meaningful traditions.

title: Backend Engineer, Data Ingestion
description:

Scribe is where exceptional people come to do the best work of their careers.   • Contribute to technical discussions, balancing short-term delivery with long-term architecture.

title: Commercial Business Partner
description:
Position Summary

The Commercial Business Analyst provides analytical, operational, and project support to the Chief Commercial Officer and the broader Commercial organization. The role translates commercial data into actionable insights, develops high-quality executive presentations, tracks strategic initiatives and commitments, and supports financial and business analysis.

This is a highly visible role for an analytically strong, organized professional who can move comfortably between data analysis, executive communication, and execution of commercial priorities.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial and Financial Analysis

  • Analyze revenue, margin, pricing, customer, product, and sales performance to identify trends, risks, and business opportunities.
  • Conduct ad hoc financial analysis and develop business cases to support commercial decisions.
  • Support analysis of regional, account, customer, and sales productivity.
  • Partner with Finance and Commercial leaders to support forecasting, planning, and performance reviews.
  • Develop and maintain key commercial KPIs and management reporting.

Executive and Business Support

  • Develop executive-quality PowerPoint presentations for leadership meetings, operating reviews, customer discussions, and other key forums.
  • Synthesize complex data and information into concise, decision-oriented materials.
  • Prepare analyses, briefing materials, and talking points for the Chief Commercial Officer.
  • Respond to ad hoc analytical and information requests from the CCO.

Commercial Execution and Project Management

  • Track key commercial initiatives, decisions, commitments, milestones, owners, and action items.
  • Coordinate follow-up across Sales, Finance, Product Management, Marketing, and other functions.
  • Support preparation and follow-through for commercial operating reviews and leadership meetings.
  • Maintain visibility to critical priorities and proactively identify actions that are at risk or require escalation.
  • Support strategic commercial projects and other CCO-sponsored initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Accounting, or a related discipline.
  • Approximately 3-5 years of relevant experience in commercial analysis, FP&A, business analysis, consulting, sales finance, corporate strategy, or a similar analytical role.
  • Strong financial and quantitative skills with the ability to analyze business performance and translate data into insights.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, including the ability to create executive-quality analyses and presentations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent organization and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Ability to work directly with senior executives and handle confidential or sensitive business information.
  • Self-directed, intellectually curious, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with limited structure.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting senior executives or commercial leadership teams in a fast-paced business environment.
  • Experience analyzing revenue, margin, pricing, customer, product, or sales performance.
  • Familiarity with CRM, ERP, business intelligence, or reporting tools; Power BI experience is a plus.
  • Experience in a global manufacturing, industrial, or other B2B environment.
  • Exposure to annual planning, forecasting, commercial operating reviews, or performance management processes.

title: CAD Modeler
description:
Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.


Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.


Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.


If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

The Role:

US defense systems run on technical data that is often decades old: scanned paper, hand-marked prints, partial models, and drawings that were never turned into 3D models. A part that exists only on an old drawing is hard to source. That slows how fast the armed forces and our prime customers can sustain and rebuild the systems that use it. Hadrian turns that data into manufacturing-ready models and drawings, so customers can keep their systems running and Hadrian can make or procure the parts.

As a CAD Modeler, you build the 3D models and 2D drawings for naval and aerospace parts, starting from whatever the customer sends. You also build the models and drawings for each manufacturing state (M-state) of a part: the in-process configurations the factory builds and inventories on the way to the final part. Our engineers define each M-state, and you model, draw, and configure it. You own your parts from first model through release and every change after it.

What You’ll Do

  • Build manufacturing-ready 3D models from naval prints, aerospace drawings, partial models, and other customer documents, matching the customer's definition feature for feature.

  • Make the 2D drawings the factory runs on, from your models or the customer's.

  • Build the models and drawings for each M-state of a part.

  • Work out conflicting or unclear views against the rest of the drawing.

  • Keep PLM data correct and structured, and send your parts through the release workflow.

  • Carry each customer change through the customer geometry and every related M-state across the part family.

  • Build models that tooling, programming, and inspection teams can use as a base.

  • Work with manufacturing teams and turn around the model and drawing changes they need.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years building production CAD models and drawings for hardware a factory made.

  • Expert use of one parametric 3D CAD application, with models the next person can change. NX preferred; CATIA, Creo, or SolidWorks also fit.

  • Experience building 3D models from complex 2D drawings with no existing model, including internal features that only show in a section view.

  • Reads and drafts GD&T per ASME Y14.5, weld and NDT symbols per AWS A2.4, and drawings to ASME Y14.100.

  • Experience releasing parts and controlling changes in a PLM system.

  • Asks when a drawing cannot answer a question instead of guessing.

  • Sets their own release schedule across many parts and switches priorities quickly.

What Will Set You Apart

  • Production work in Siemens NX.

  • Experience with naval or shipyard drawings, customer data packages, and old or hand-drawn prints.

  • Has modeled and drawn in-process (M-state) configurations that differ from the final customer definition.

  • Has run a customer change process and an internal change process at the same time.

  • Background in machined parts, welded assemblies, tooling, and CMM or scan inspection.

  • Spots when one parametric model can cover a whole family of part numbers, and builds it that way.

Compensation

For this role, the target salary range is 98,000 - 167,000 (actual range may vary based on experience).

This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee's pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Benefits for Full-time Employees

  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees
    401k

  • Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need.

  • Flexible vacation policy

  • Equity

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Use of AI in hiring

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy.

Consideration of Criminal History

Hadrian will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of all applicable laws. We do not ask about criminal history on our application, and we do not consider criminal history before making a conditional offer of employment.

Hadrian Is An Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Backend Engineer – Real-Time Video
description:
About Stream

Stream powers real-time Chat, Video, Activity Feeds, and AI Moderation for more than 1 billion end users across 4,000+ apps, from Strava and Bumble to eBay and Patreon. Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low-latency services and a great developer experience.

The role

We're looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to join Stream on our mission of elevating the quality of apps for billions of users globally. You'll own the technical direction of Stream Video's media plane and the infrastructure it runs on.

This is a full-time role, hybrid with 3 days a week in our Amsterdam office, or remote from anywhere in the EU.

What you'll work on

Stream Video runs on an SFU we built in Go on top of Pion, plus ingest and recording fleets, all on a global edge network we own across more than one cloud. Nobody at Stream has owned this media plane end to end before. Our central infrastructure team is tuned for request-based services, and video breaks in different ways: live sessions can't be dropped, bandwidth is the biggest cost, and placement is the main lever. That's why this is a Staff role. You'll set the direction for the video backend and its infrastructure with your own roadmap, reporting to our Director of Engineering with a direct line to our CTO. The Video SDK teams own the client side, and you'll work closely with them and with infrastructure. Part of the fleet is mid-move to Kubernetes.

Job responsibilities:

  • Architecture: write the architecture and roadmap for Stream Video's backend and media infrastructure, and decide what ships.

  • Scale livestreaming: architect the SFU and media pipeline (WHIP, WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, SVC), including the path from WebRTC to CDN-backed HLS for very large audiences.

  • Own the fleet: reliability, autoscaling, placement, rollouts, observability and cost for long-lived sessions across clouds, with cost per gigabyte as a first-class metric.

  • Gate production changes: define the validation that decides which changes, including AI-generated ones, reach live media, using behaviour tests on realistic networks, nightly telemetry scans and a public quality benchmark.

  • Take the final escalation: handle the hardest quality, latency and production incidents, and work with enterprise customers on advanced integrations.

  • Raise the bar: mentor senior engineers through design review, code review and hiring.

About you

You've owned systems where a dropped session or a bad rollout is visible to users within seconds, and you think about cost and reliability as much as features. You'd rather write the hard design doc than wait for one. A founder background is an asset here. The team is small, so you'll still write and review plenty of code. If you're looking for a large organisation with a platform team to hand problems to, or a management track, this role won't suit you.

You have:

  • Extensive backend engineering experience, including significant time owning architecture for high-scale production systems

  • Expert proficiency in Go or an equivalent systems language (Rust, C++, Java)

  • A track record owning real-time, stateful or latency-sensitive systems at very high scale

  • Deep knowledge of distributed systems and networking: failure modes, placement, capacity planning and cost

  • Strong experience with real-time media or streaming: WebRTC, SFU/MCU concepts, RTP/RTCP, DTLS, or RTMP, SRT and HLS

  • Clear written communication: design docs and RFCs that others can act on

  • Hands-on experience adopting AI coding and agent tools, and judgement on how to make them safe in production

Bonus points:

  • Built or operated an SFU, or contributed to Pion or another WebRTC stack

  • Moved a stateful fleet to Kubernetes, or ran media workloads across more than one cloud

  • Knowledge of bandwidth estimation, congestion control, simulcast, SVC and codecs (Opus, VP8/VP9, AV1)

  • CockroachDB/PostgreSQL, RocksDB, Raft and Redis at scale

  • Experience at developer tooling, API or SDK companies

  • Founder or early-stage startup experience building real-time products

  • Python or Rust alongside Go

  • Conference talks, technical writing or notable open-source work in real-time media

What makes this role exciting

  • Scope: the infrastructure direction for video is yours to run as a product, with the authority to decide what ships.

  • Impact: Video is Stream's most complex product, and many customers run it alongside Chat, Feeds and Moderation, so this work matters across the company.

  • Stack: Go, Pion, WebRTC, WHIP/WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, Protobuf, CockroachDB/Postgres, RocksDB, Raft and Redis, with Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT Codex in daily use.

  • Starting point: a concrete first 90 days. Ship a validation gate on every infrastructure change that reaches production media, and move part of the fleet to Kubernetes with a cost-per-gigabyte number attached.

Why join Stream?

We're a Series B company with offices in Boulder, Amsterdam, Skopje and Toronto, and a team of 140+ people from 37 nationalities. We're backed by Felicis Ventures, GGV Capital, 01 Advisors, Techstars, and Arthur Ventures, with angels including Dick Costolo (ex-CEO of Twitter), Olivier Pomel (CEO of Datadog), Tom Preston-Werner (co-founder of GitHub), and Nicolas Dessaigne (co-founder of Algolia).

We'll be straight with you: a startup is more demanding than a large company. There's no fixed playbook, you'll own things end to end, and you'll sometimes pick up work outside your title. That's also what makes it a fast place to grow. If you want real ownership and high scale more than structure and a set career ladder, you'll feel at home here.

What we offer

  • Company equity

  • 28 days paid time off plus Dutch public holidays

  • Pension plan with a company contribution

  • NS Business Card or a company bike, covered

  • Personal development budget of EUR 500 per year

  • Catered lunches in the office

  • MacBook Pro

  • Up to EUR 60 a month toward a gym or sports club membership of your choice

  • Highly skilled migrant (kennismigrant) visa sponsorship and relocation support if you're moving to Amsterdam

This list applies to Netherlands-based employees and is adjusted to your location of residence. If you work remotely from another EU country, you'll be employed through our Employer of Record partner and get company equity plus local benefits depending on your country of employment.

Our culture

Stream is a casual, transparent team that aims high and supports each other. In engineering, we care about ownership and quality, and our goal is to ship stable software. Management stays hands-on, with less middle management and more time spent doing the work. If that sounds like the environment you want next, apply now.

Stream is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on skills and experience, and we don't discriminate based on age, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, nationality, religion or belief, political opinion, disability or chronic illness, marital status, working hours, type of contract, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need an adjustment at any point in our hiring process, let us know.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Note for external recruiters: We currently have this role covered and do not accept unsolicited agency resumes. We are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Staff Data Scientist - Wildfire
description:
Role & Team

We are excited to add a Staff Data Scientist, Wildfire to our team. This individual will lead the scientific foundation of our Fuel Detection Model, the core engine that translates satellite and environmental data into an understanding of vegetation structure, fuel loads, and wildfire risk.

Working alongside ML engineers, and a product team, you'll define accuracy for our models, design the research and validation methods that prove it, and ensure our modeling choices are grounded in fire science and remote sensing fundamentals. This is a great opportunity for someone who is energized by open scientific questions with direct real-world stakes, and who wants their research to shape how utilities prevent catastrophic wildfires.

Time Zone Requirement: North America (NST, AST, EST, CST, MST, PST)

What You’ll Do

  • Lead research into how vegetation structure, fuel conditions, and wildfire risk can be estimated from satellite, LiDAR, and environmental data across diverse geographies

  • Design rigorous validation and evaluation methodologies, including ground-truth strategies, uncertainty quantification, and error analysis tied to real-world impact

  • Prototype and refine ML modeling approaches, then partner with ML engineers to translate them into production systems

  • Integrate established fire science, such as fuel models and fire behavior frameworks, with data-driven methods

  • Define scientific standards for experimentation, reproducibility, and model interpretability across the modeling organization

  • Communicate research findings clearly to engineers, product teams, customers, and the broader wildfire science community

  • Mentor ML engineers on scientific methodology and domain reasoning

Skills & Experience

  • 8+ years of applied research or data science experience in wildfire science, fire ecology, forestry, remote sensing, atmospheric science, or a related quantitative field

  • Deep expertise in remote sensing and geospatial analysis, including working with satellite imagery and large-scale environmental datasets

  • Strong statistical modeling and machine learning skills in Python, with tools like GeoPandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, or XGBoost

  • Track record of designing validation studies and evaluation frameworks for environmental or geospatial models

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to make complex scientific work legible across technical and non-technical audience

Nice To Have

  • Familiarity with fire behavior or fuels modeling frameworks (e.g., Rothermel-based models, LANDFIRE fuel classifications)

  • Experience integrating physics-based models with ML, or with active learning and uncertainty quantification

  • Peer-reviewed publications in wildfire science, remote sensing, or environmental modeling

  • Familiarity with GCP, Vertex AI, or similar cloud-based platforms

  • Experience in remote-first or globally distributed team

Note: We believe that all people are capable of great things. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all of the requirements that are listed within this job description.

What We Offer

  • Competitive, location-specific compensation and benefits

  • Flexible, autonomous and collaborative working environment rooted in trust - we build our work days around our lives, not the other way around

  • Home office stipend, co-working and ongoing education budgets

  • A company culture that genuinely embodies each of our core values

  • To be part of truly mission-driven work that reduces wildfires, protects earth’s natural resources and helps solve our climate crisis

A premier digital product and technology consulting firm specializing in modern software engineering, cloud-native architecture, and strategic digital transformation across high-impact sectors including healthcare, financial services, and education.


Job Summary

The Senior Full-Stack Growth Engineer plays a pivotal role in designing, building, and evolving the technical infrastructure that powers customer acquisition, experimentation, and marketing performance. This unique position bridges end-to-end full-stack software development with rigorous quantitative analysis to drive measurable business impact. The ideal candidate will architect production features and internal tools, build resilient API and CRM integrations, instrument deep product analytics, and design statistically sound experiments across the entire user lifecycle. Collaborating closely with cross-functional product, design, and growth teams, this role turns critical business hypotheses into high-impact, shippable solutions supported by clean data and causal measurement.

Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain production-ready full-stack features, backend services, web applications, and internal growth tools.

  • Design, deploy, and evaluate experiments across customer acquisition, onboarding flows, conversion funnels, and retention loops.

  • Apply statistical inference and causal reasoning to evaluate A/B test results, identify confounding factors, and communicate uncertainty clearly to stakeholders.

  • Implement robust event tracking, instrumentation, and product analytics using modern platforms (e.g., PostHog).

  • Integrate advertising platforms, CRMs, databases, and third-party tools via REST/GraphQL APIs, webhooks, and event-driven data pipelines.

  • Evolve database schemas and analytical data models to support new product workflows, attribution, and reliable measurement.

  • Connect acquisition, product usage, CRM, and revenue data streams to analyze full-funnel customer journeys and business outcomes.

  • Maintain high standards for data quality, automated testing, observability, user privacy, and data security across all integrations.

  • Collaborate with marketing, product, and design partners to translate strategic growth objectives into testable engineering roadmaps.

  • Leverage modern AI-assisted engineering and analytical workflows responsibly, ensuring rigorous validation and data governance.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Proven track record as a Full-Stack Software Engineer building modern web applications, scalable backend APIs, and working with relational databases.

  • Advanced SQL proficiency alongside hands-on scripting/analytical experience in Python, R, or equivalent modern data tools.

  • Practical foundation in experimental design, A/B testing methodologies, statistical inference, and causal reasoning.

  • Hands-on experience implementing product analytics instrumentation, event pipelines, and auditing data quality.

  • Solid experience architecting third-party integrations using webhooks, APIs, and event-driven patterns.

  • Strong ability to translate complex data findings and technical tradeoffs into actionable business and product insights.

  • Practical experience with AI-assisted software development and analytical tooling, backed by sound engineering judgment regarding validation and security.

Preferred / Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with PostHog, CRM platforms, marketing automation engines, Conversion APIs (CAPI), or server-side tracking.

  • Familiarity with growth metrics such as CAC, LTV, churn/retention curves, and ROAS.

  • Understanding of incrementality testing, conversion lift studies, and attribution model nuances.

  • Background in consulting, client-facing delivery, or building software in regulated environments (e.g., healthcare, fintech).

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

  • Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field.

Apply now!

title: Staff Software Engineer, Traffic Team
description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, United States

Overview

GitHub is changing the way the world builds software, and we want you to help lead this effort.

The Traffic Team plays a critical role in GitHub's scalability and resiliency. GitHub’s Traffic team is responsible for every packet into and out of GitHub’s edge and delivers a foundational load balancing platform for all of its services. The team’s objective is to ensure that GitHub continues to operate industry-leading services at global scale, and to ensure internal engineering teams have the tools and processes necessary to build on top of our platform with as little friction as possible.

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Traffic Team, you will work closely with a distributed, diverse, and passionate team of engineers to improve and maintain part of the platform that millions of developers worldwide rely on in their software development cycle.

The Traffic Team is highly distributed, and you will thrive in an environment of remote work and asynchronous communication. You're expected to have strong written communication skills and be able to develop working relationships with coworkers in locations around the globe. As an engineer at GitHub, you'll always be challenged to solve interesting and novel problems that have a real impact on how the world builds software.


Responsibilities

  • Lead technical decision making and architecture

  • Design and implement scalable, reliable and performant solutions for complex problems like rate-limiting, routing, etc.

  • Maintain and improve the GitHub Load Balancer, and other systems related to traffic management at GitHub

  • Write, review, and maintain code primary in Go and Ruby & Rails

  • Mentor other engineers in their technical and architectural decision making

  • Participate in the on-call rotation, and team meetings


Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • 9+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python
    • OR Associate’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 8+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python
    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field AND 7+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python
    • OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 5+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python.
    • OR Doctorate in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 3+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python.
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 4+ years building and supporting large, high traffic applications at scale within platform/infrastructure domains
  • 4+ years supporting and building cloud native workloads in Azure, AWS or Google Cloud
  • 2+ years experience maintaining a Load Balancer with proven experience in abuse protection mechanisms for DDoS attacks, load shedding, etc.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with HAProxy, or any other open-source Load Balancer

  • 2+ Years of Golang experience

  • Experience building or maintaining planetary scale engineering systems

  • Experience working with a remote, distributed team

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills


Compensation Range

The base salary range for this job is USD $140,400.00 - USD $372,300.00 /Yr.

These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. At GitHub certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role.

This position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

GitHub values

  • Customer-obsessed
  • Ship to learn
  • Growth mindset
  • Own the outcome
  • Better together
  • Diverse and inclusive

Manager fundamentals

  • Model
  • Coach
  • Care

Leadership principles

  • Create clarity
  • Generate energy
  • Deliver success

Who We Are

GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

EEO Statement

GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences.
