title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
At Didero, we’re building the autonomous supply chain, starting with agentic supplier management.

Global trade has never been more complex or more critical. Teams are underwater, reacting to a flood of challenges — from geopolitical risk to tariffs. Didero helps by automating time-intensive workflows with AI agents, deploying cutting-edge technology into one of the world’s most vital domains.

We’re backed by some of the world’s best venture funds and leading figures across AI, supply chain, and enterprise software.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer to join our team. This role is ideal for a technically strong, customer-facing engineer who can understand complex customer operations, question requirements, design scalable solutions, and build the systems needed to deploy Didero successfully.

You will work directly with our enterprise and strategic customers to understand their end-to-end procurement and operations workflows including ERP integrations, data pipelines, workflow automation, supplier communication flows, reporting, and custom deployment needs. You will translate messy real-world processes into reliable, maintainable technical systems.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will build backend systems, integrations, APIs, data pipelines, and workflow automations using the best technical approach for the problem. While our core platform is built with Django, we care more about solving customer problems than using any single technology. You'll use the right tools and technologies for each integration or deployment.

You will work with systems such as NetSuite, SAP, Microsoft Business Central, Zip, and other procurement, ERP, finance, and operational platforms. You will also partner closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Forward Deployed teams to ensure customer deployments are scalable and aligned with our product direction.

We are looking for someone who is not just an implementer. The right person is a systems thinker who asks why, challenges assumptions, pushes back on unclear requirements, and helps customers arrive at better solutions.

Please Note: This is a hybrid role based in NYC and may involve occasional on-site work with customers, approximately 1-2 per month, to support discovery sessions, technical workshops, and deployment phases.

What You’ll Do

  • Work directly with customers to understand their procurement, finance, ERP, and operational workflows.

  • Question and clarify customer requirements, identifying the underlying business need rather than blindly implementing requests.

  • Design and build integrations with ERP, procurement, finance, and operational systems.

  • Build backend services, APIs, data pipelines, workflow automations, and customer-specific technical solutions.

  • Translate ambiguous customer processes into structured, scalable system designs.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to identify repeatable patterns that should become part of the core platform.

  • Debug complex integration issues across customer systems, third-party APIs, data models, and internal services.

  • Support customer discovery, deployment planning, and technical implementation.

  • Help define best practices for forward-deployed engineering, customer pipelines, and integration architecture.

You’ll be successful in this role if you…

  • Thrive in ambiguity and make steady progress without perfectly defined requirements.

  • Think in systems, connecting customer workflows, data, and software into scalable solutions.

  • Partner directly with customers to uncover root problems rather than simply implementing requests.

  • Challenge assumptions and refine requirements before writing code.

  • Exercise strong engineering judgment, knowing when to build custom solutions, create reusable abstractions, or push back.

  • Balance customer-specific needs with long-term product thinking by identifying repeatable patterns.

  • Debug complex integration and distributed systems problems methodically.

  • Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience with strong backend expertise.

  • Strong experience building backend services using Python and/or Django (or comparable backend technologies).

  • Experience designing and building integrations with external systems, APIs, enterprise software, or data pipelines.

  • Experience working directly with customers or cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, API design, debugging, and systems architecture.

  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience working in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or Implementation Engineering.

  • Prior experience integrating multiple ERP systems.

  • Familiarity with SAP OData services, NetSuite SuiteTalk/SuiteScript, Microsoft Business Central APIs.

  • Experience with async processing (Celery, Redis, RabbitMQ) for large data sync jobs.

  • Familiarity with Docker, cloud deployment (AWS/Azure/GCP).

  • Knowledge of financial/accounting workflows and supply chain processes.

Tech Stack

Django · Python · React · TypeScript

What we value at Didero

  • We go beyond OTIF. We’re obsessed with our customers and go above and beyond to ensure we’re their top supplier. We work hard to earn and maintain their trust.

  • Own it. We own what we do. We stand behind the quality of our work and do the right thing, especially when it costs us.

  • Move fast. Learn faster. We have a strong bias to action and shorten the cycle by following our curiosity to improve as we go.

  • Be relentless. When one route closes, we find another.

  • Disagree, then commit. This is an open contest of ideas. We’re direct, but with respect. We’re decisive, and everyone commits because we win together.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation and equity

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Memberships for One Medical, Talkspace, Teladoc, and Kindbody

  • Unlimited PTO — we trust you to take the time you need

  • Monthly wellness stipend via ClassPass

  • Tech equipment for your setup

  • Catered lunches (for those in the office)

title: Senior Test Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE JOB

We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Test Engineer to build the test infrastructure behind Arxlight’s hardware products from the ground up.

You’ll develop the tools, fixtures, automation and test systems that tell us quickly whether our hardware works, where it fails and whether it’s ready to ship. That spans individual components, subsystems, fully assembled drones and production units. There’s no existing test lab or set of procedures to inherit. You’ll decide what gets built first and build it, often while the hardware it’s testing is still changing.

You’ll work closely with Hardware, Software, Manufacturing and Flight Test to turn product requirements and real-world failure modes into practical, repeatable tests. When a flight test turns up something unexpected or a build needs to be cleared to ship, you’ll be the one who gets the answer, without waiting for a ticket. This role suits someone who likes building things, breaking things and digging into data, and who wants testing to keep pace with a team that moves fast.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Design and build test infrastructure for drones and their subsystems, including test fixtures, automated test equipment, data acquisition, and hardware-in-the-loop test setups.

  • Develop automated test software and scripts to run tests, collect data, analyze results, and quickly identify failures and performance issues.

  • Build test coverage across electronics, sensors, cameras, batteries, motors, communications, flight systems, and fully assembled drones.

  • Develop environmental, stress, endurance, reliability, and lifecycle tests that represent how the product will actually be used in the field.

  • Own test methods from early prototypes through NPI and production, turning engineering tests into repeatable systems that can be used across the company.

  • Work directly with Engineering and Manufacturing to investigate failures, find root causes, improve designs, and make sure test results lead to real product improvements.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in hardware test, systems test, validation, reliability, or test engineering for complex hardware products.

  • Strong experience building test fixtures, automated test equipment, data acquisition systems, instrumentation, and hardware/software test setups.

  • Strong programming and automation skills using Python or similar languages, with experience working with test equipment, APIs, serial interfaces, CAN, Ethernet, or other hardware communication protocols.

  • Broad understanding of electronics, embedded systems, sensors, batteries, motors, communications, and electromechanical systems, with the ability to troubleshoot across disciplines.

  • Experience developing test plans, defining pass/fail criteria, analyzing large amounts of test data, and turning failures into actionable engineering feedback.

  • Comfortable working hands-on in the lab, building your own test setups, troubleshooting unfamiliar problems, and moving quickly when the product or requirements are changing.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience testing drones, robotics, autonomous systems, aerospace hardware, or other complex electromechanical products.

  • Experience with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), software-in-the-loop (SIL), flight simulation, or automated system-level testing.

  • Experience with environmental and reliability testing including thermal cycling, vibration, shock, ingress, drop, endurance, and accelerated life testing.

  • Experience testing batteries, power systems, motors, ESCs, cameras, sensors, radios, GPS/GNSS, and other common drone subsystems.

  • Experience developing production test systems and transitioning engineering test methods into reliable, repeatable manufacturing tests.

  • Experience in a startup or fast-moving hardware company where you’re expected to build the test infrastructure, not just run an established test process.

Role Summary:


The Lead Software Engineer provides technical leadership while remaining hands-on in the design, development, and delivery of software solutions. This role operates above the Senior Software Engineer level and is accountable for architectural guidance compliance, code quality, engineering best practices, and mentoring across one or more teams. The Lead Software Engineer partners with Product, Architecture, and Engineering leadership to ensure systems are scalable, secure, maintainable, and aligned with organizational technology standards. The role also includes responsibility for adopting and applying AI-assisted engineering practices to improve productivity, quality, and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Leadership

  • Lead technical design and architectural decisions for features, services, or platforms.
  • Ensure adherence to engineering standards, design patterns, security practices, and performance requirements.
  • Review and approve technical designs and code changes.
  • Decompose epics and features into technical tasks and implementation plans.
  • Identify technical risks, dependencies, and trade-offs and propose mitigation strategies.
  • Lead root-cause analysis and resolution of complex production issues.

Software Development

  • Write and maintain unit, integration, and automated tests.
  • Ensure production readiness, reliability, and observability of systems.
  • Maintain ownership of supported applications and services.

AI-Assisted Engineering

  • Apply AI-assisted development tools to improve code quality, testing, and documentation.
  • Use AI to support code reviews, refactoring, test generation, and defect analysis.
  • Evaluate AI capabilities for improving CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and operational efficiency.
  • Ensure responsible and secure use of AI tools in accordance with organizational policies.
  • Contribute to defining standards and best practices for AI adoption within engineering teams.

Mentorship and Team Enablement

  • Mentor senior, mid-level, and junior engineers on design, coding practices, and problem solving.
  • Provide technical guidance through code reviews, design sessions, and peer programming.
  • Support skill development in cloud, DevOps, and AI-related engineering practices.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, quality, and continuous improvement.

Cloud, DevOps and Operations

  • Lead the use of cloud-native and serverless architectures.
  • Oversee infrastructure health, cost optimization, security posture, and performance.
  • Improve CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
  • Ensure operational excellence and production support readiness.

Role Expectations:

  • Technical Ownership: Accountable for end-to-end technical delivery of assigned systems or domains.
  • Architectural Influence: Contributes to system and platform-level technical direction.
  • Decision-Making: Makes informed technical decisions balancing quality, speed, cost, and risk.
  • Adaptability: Adjusts technical approaches in response to changing requirements or priorities.
  • Continuous Learning: Maintains current knowledge of software engineering, cloud, DevOps, and AI technologies.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 6 years’ experience in a related field. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as a master’s degree and 4 years’ experience; a Ph.D. and 1 year of experience; or 18 years’ experience in a related field.
  • Strong experience designing and building web-based or distributed systems.
  • Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages such as Python, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Experience building and deploying applications in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Experience with Git-based version control and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Demonstrated experience leading technical initiatives and mentoring engineers.

AI Skills and Competencies

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools for coding, testing, and documentation.
  • Ability to evaluate AI-generated outputs for correctness, security, and maintainability.
  • Understanding of prompt design, context management, and limitations of AI tools.
  • Experience integrating AI services or APIs into software systems.
  • Knowledge of data privacy, security, and ethical considerations related to AI usage.
  • Ability to guide teams in effective and responsible AI adoption.

Level Differentiation Compared to Senior Software Engineer

title: Bank Associate
description:
Position Function:

The Bank Associate position is designed to develop future banking professionals by providing broad exposure to underwriting, credit analysis, lending practices, and the Bank’s approach to managing risk and serving customers. This position is for individuals interested in building a long-term career in banking, with the goal of preparing successful participants to transition into an Underwriter position upon completion of the one-year program and pursue future career opportunities, including advancement toward a Banking Officer role. Through a combination of rotational assignments, on-the-job and classroom training, formalized feedback, coaching, and mentoring, Bank Associates will gain hands-on experience in credit analysis, financial analysis, risk assessment, loan structuring, and other fundamental aspects of the underwriting process while contributing to Central Pacific Bank' s strategic initiatives. The program also emphasizes personal and professional development, providing opportunities to strengthen communication, critical thinking, collaboration, leadership, and other skills essential to becoming a high-level contributor and trusted banking professional. During the program, Bank Associates will work alongside experienced banking professionals and accept delegated responsibilities and duties appropriate to their level of development.

title: Sr. Staff Hardware Systems Architect - Connectivity/Wireless
description:
About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

As an hardware architect, you will lead efforts within the Hardware Systems Architecture team to develop a full understanding of wireless/connectivity related product features and attributes, collaborate cross-functionally to decompose them into technical requirements, and ultimately define their respective vehicle sub-system and constituent module architectures. In later stages of development, you will leverage these insights to support the definition of system performance criteria and methodologies for the validation team to test these systems against their requirements.

This role spans the full range of wireless technologies including WiFi, BT/BLE, 4G/5G, GNSS, V2X, and UWB as they relate to vehicle sub-system for telematics, infotainment, vehicle access, and related domains, ultimately driving their respective RF, network, compute and power architectures.

Responsibilities

  • Work cross-functionally with hardware architecture, systems engineers, hardware design and software application teams to factor functional, performance, industry and regulatory requirements into their respective sub-systems, identify the key metrics and trade-offs, and optimize them using data and analysis, to distill clear system-level and module-level architecture requirements.

  • Model system-level trade-offs concerning distributed compute, network and other resources, considering dimensions like power efficiency, end-to-end latencies, compute/memory utilization, and scalability, to help produce optimal systems architectures.

  • Establish key vendor and industry relationships to map the space of available and future connectivity standards and technologies, and use this to build out a scalable connectivity/wireless roadmap for RVT

  • Guide the development of mock-ups or prototypes to study next-gen technologies, establish proofs-of-concept, test modelled assumptions, and/or serve as reference platforms.

  • Support the effort of the system validation team to build comprehensive test plans that surface key system-level performance metrics, locate bottlenecks or chokepoints, and identify over-/under-design scenarios relative to the defining system requirements.

Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field, and a track record of 8+ years of hands-on experience in relevant industries, including automotive, aerospace, or relevant consumer applications.

  • Deep familiarity with the landscape of wireless technologies related to typical automotive applications like telematics (LTE, 5G), infotainment (WiFi, BT), geolocation (GNSS), secure entry (BLE, UWB, NFC), ADAS (V2X), and their metrics and methodologies for performance evaluation at the RF, protocol and systems application levels.

  • Familiarity with system design and/or certification related to Connect Car Consortium (CCC) and/or Made for iPhone (MFi) keyless entry systems at the module and system levels.

  • Experience designing and/or validating embedded RF systems optimized for distributed architecture settings, including automotive, aerospace, robotics or other analogous domains.

  • Foundation in RF and electrical engineering fundamentals, and hands-on familiarity with related test and measurement equipment, e.g., logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, DMMs, network analyzers, etc.

  • Solid grasp of the power related aspects of distributed embedded architectures, including efficient utilization of low-power states, wake propagation and sequencing.

  • Conversant with wireless technologies like GNSS, BLE, LTE, 5G, Wi-Fi, and/or UWB, and their performance evaluation at the protocol and systems integration levels.

Total Rewards

We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program.

Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements.

In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. Offerings vary by country. Learn more about our global benefit programs.

title: Software Engineer - Cloud & DevSecOps
description:
Software Engineer – Cloud & DevSecOps (RDT&E)

Location: Dahlgren, VA

Full-Time with benefits

Salary Range: $120K-$140K

Position Overview

Strategic Data Systems is seeking an experienced Software Engineer – Cloud & DevOps to support the Naval Surface Warfare Center Dahlgren Division (NSWCDD) Research, Development, Test & Evaluation (RDT&E) environment in Dahlgren, Virginia.

This position offers an opportunity for an accomplished software engineering professional to contribute to the design, development, integration, deployment, and modernization of mission-critical applications and supporting infrastructure within a complex Department of Defense (DoD) technical environment.

The successful candidate will bring a strong combination of software development expertise, cloud engineering experience, DevOps automation capabilities, and advanced technical troubleshooting skills. This individual will support the complete software development lifecycle while helping shape technical solutions, improve development practices, strengthen system reliability, and enhance operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

    Software Engineering and Application Development

    • Design, develop, maintain, and enhance secure, scalable, and high-performance web applications supporting mission-critical RDT&E operations.
    • Contribute to software architecture and technical design decisions, emphasizing maintainability, reliability, performance, and long-term sustainability.
    • Develop and maintain application functionality using modern programming languages and frameworks, including JavaScript and related full-stack technologies.
    • Support the integration of applications with enterprise data sources, analytics platforms, reporting systems, and supporting infrastructure.
    • Develop and execute comprehensive automated testing strategies, including unit, functional, integration, performance, and acceptance testing.
    • Conduct code reviews, identify opportunities for optimization, and promote software engineering best practices.
    • Diagnose and resolve complex application issues through systematic troubleshooting, debugging, and root-cause analysis.
    • Identify opportunities to modernize legacy applications, streamline development processes, and improve overall software quality.

      • Cloud Engineering and Infrastructure Support

      • Support the development, deployment, configuration, and maintenance of applications operating within Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS) environments.
      • Troubleshoot complex technical issues spanning application code, cloud infrastructure, networking, and supporting services.
      • Evaluate cloud-hosted application performance, availability, security, and operational efficiency.
      • Collaborate with infrastructure and cybersecurity teams to ensure applications are properly configured, secured, monitored, and maintained.
      • Support Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), virtualization, and hybrid cloud solutions.
      • Recommend improvements to cloud architectures, deployment strategies, and operational processes to enhance reliability and scalability.
      • Assist with application and infrastructure lifecycle planning, deployment coordination, upgrades, and sustainment activities.

        • DevSecOps, Automation, and Containerization

        • Design, develop, maintain, and optimize Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines using GitLab.
        • Implement automation solutions that improve development efficiency, deployment consistency, and software delivery reliability.
        • Support GitLab version control, repository management, pipeline configuration, and automated testing integration.
        • Develop, configure, and maintain Helm charts supporting containerized application deployments.
        • Support application deployment and troubleshooting within Docker and Kubernetes environments.
        • Identify and resolve deployment failures, configuration inconsistencies, and pipeline performance issues.
        • Implement secure configuration and secrets management practices utilizing HashiCorp Vault.
        • Collaborate with development, operations, and cybersecurity personnel to strengthen DevSecOps practices throughout the software development lifecycle.
        • Evaluate opportunities to reduce manual processes through scripting, automation, and improved engineering workflows.

          • Cybersecurity and Secure Software Development

          • Incorporate security considerations throughout application design, development, testing, and deployment activities.
          • Apply secure coding standards and development practices consistent with applicable DoD cybersecurity requirements.
          • Support vulnerability identification, remediation, code validation, and security testing activities.
          • Collaborate with cybersecurity professionals to address application and infrastructure security concerns.
          • Maintain awareness of security requirements affecting cloud-hosted applications, containerized environments, and software deployment processes.
          • Support compliance documentation, audit readiness, and adherence to organizational security policies.
          • Identify opportunities to improve security automation and strengthen the overall security posture of supported applications.

            • Technical Leadership and Customer Engagement

            • Serve as a trusted technical resource and subject matter expert for software engineering, cloud deployment, and DevOps-related activities.
            • Collaborate directly with government stakeholders, engineering personnel, system administrators, and cybersecurity teams to understand requirements and develop effective technical solutions.
            • Provide informed recommendations regarding application architecture, deployment strategies, technical risks, and engineering improvements.
            • Independently investigate complex technical challenges and develop practical, sustainable resolutions.
            • Participate in technical planning sessions, design reviews, and discussions concerning system modernization and operational improvements.
            • Mentor and share technical knowledge with other team members to promote consistent engineering practices and professional development.
            • Develop and maintain technical documentation, configuration procedures, troubleshooting guides, and standard operating procedures.
            • Communicate technical findings, recommendations, and potential operational impacts clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Required Qualifications


    • Five to eight (5–8) years of relevant professional experience in software engineering, full-stack development, cloud engineering, DevOps, or closely related technical disciplines.
    • IAT Level 2 certification such as CompTIA Security+
    • Top Secret security clearance
    • Demonstrated experience developing, maintaining, and troubleshooting enterprise-level web applications.
    • Strong working knowledge of JavaScript and modern software development principles.
    • Hands-on experience supporting applications or infrastructure within Microsoft Azure and/or AWS cloud environments.
    • Demonstrated experience with GitLab, including version control, CI/CD pipeline development, configuration, optimization, and automation.
    • Experience implementing automated software testing and validation processes.
    • Working knowledge of containerized application deployment practices, including Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.
    • Experience with HashiCorp Vault or comparable secure secrets management technologies.
    • Strong understanding of software architecture, application integration, and the software development lifecycle.
    • Demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues across software, infrastructure, and cloud environments.

title: Principal Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

Docker Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) embed directly with our most strategic customers to solve important, complex technical problems and turn ambitious ideas into production outcomes. FDEs take on the most challenging technical challenges using existing Docker products and patterns when possible, and work across customer, Docker Product and Engineering teams to realize new approaches when required.

As a Docker FDE, you will work side-by-side with customer engineering teams to deeply understand their goals, problems, constraints, and technical landscape; identify the highest-leverage opportunities; and design, build, and ship solutions with them. You own the technical journey from discovery and architecture through prototyping, implementation and production rollout.

The solutions you build may use existing Docker products, extend Docker into new environments, integrate deeply with customer and third-party systems, or reveal capabilities that Docker should build next. You work closely with Docker Solutions Architects to evolve existing patterns, and Docker Product and Engineering to turn new learnings into reusable patterns and product capabilities.

Responsibilities

Build in Production with Customers

  • Embed with customer engineering teams to design, build, and ship solutions from first prototype through stable production rollout. Use existing Docker products and patterns when possible, invent, prototype and validate innovative solutions when necessary.

  • Deliver working technical artifacts to customers: custom MCP servers with tightly integrated Docker Sandbox environments for coding agents and containerized agents; Docker Compose definitions for multi-agent harnesses and model-backed applications; Hardened Image standardization and migration; New tools that unblock customer progress.

  • Integrate Docker's AI platform with the customer's existing stack, including identity providers (OIDC/SAML/SSO), secrets management, private and air-gapped registries, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling.

  • Own technical delivery on your engagements: scope the work, sequence it, make trade-offs between speed and quality, remove blockers early, and contribute directly to code whenever progress depends on it.

Make AI Adoption Safe and Governable

  • Translate customer security, compliance, and platform requirements into concrete plans and see those plans through from ideation to production.

  • Help customers define controls to enable them to adopt agentic AI to solve their unique business problems without compromising security, compliance, data sovereignty or end-user experience.

  • Establish quality and performance standards for customers and work closely with Docker Product and Engineering to quickly address issues that fall outside of established thresholds

  • Partner with customer security and platform teams to get agentic workloads through architecture review, threat modeling, and change control.

Partner with Solutions Architecture and the Field

  • Work closely with Solutions Architects to enable off-the-self solutions when possible and provide technical experience and leadership when a bespoke solution is necessary.

  • Feed implementation learnings back into reference architectures, SOW templates, and success patterns so that FDE innovations become standard features and implementation patterns.

  • Support the field with technical depth during proofs of concept, escalations, and expansion conversations when a working build is the fastest path to a customer adoption.

Close the Loop with Product and Engineering

  • As part of Docker Engineering FDEs work closely with Product and Engineering teams to fold FDE innovations, learnings, and design patterns into existing or new products and services.

  • Work with Customers, Product and Engineering to establish quality and performance thresholds, ensuring customer environments meet them consistently, and responding quickly and decisively when they don’t.

  • Be the voice of the customer. Deliver data-driven and actionable feedback to Product and Engineering: what works well; what does not; what customers are asking for; and what blocks their adoption and forward progress. FDE experience directly influences the roadmap.

Shape the Practice

  • Define the FDE engagement model, delivery standards, and quality bar, and codify them so that engagements are consistent across customers, regions, and delivery partners.

  • Mentor and lead other Forward Deployed Engineers, and participate in hiring loops to grow the team.

  • Act as the senior technical escalation point on the hardest problems impacting your customers. Every incident is an opportunity to improve Docker products and services.

  • Maintain deep, current knowledge of the agentic AI stack: LLMs, APIs, MCP, coding agents, model and harness evaluation approaches, performance and quality thresholds, deployment patterns.

  • This role may require participation in an on-call rotation to provide support outside of standard business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as needed.

Qualifications

Required

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role such as Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Professional Services Engineer, or Software Engineer with consulting or technical founder experience.

  • Technical leadership across multiple engagements, teams, or domains, with a proven ability to set delivery standards, define repeatable patterns, and influence product direction through field evidence.

  • Expert production coding skills in Go, Python, or TypeScript, with a track record of shipping and operating software that other people depend on and of leading technical design reviews.

  • Deep, hands-on Docker expertise: Dockerfiles and multi-stage builds, Docker Compose, image and registry operations, container networking and storage, and container security fundamentals.

  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agents in production, including tool use and function calling, the Model Context Protocol (MCP server and client implementation), prompt and context engineering, and evaluation of agent behavior.

  • Working knowledge of software supply chain security: SBOMs, image signing and attestation, vulnerability management, minimal and hardened base images, and secure CI/CD.

  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems: identity providers (Okta, Entra ID, LDAP/Active Directory), federated identity protocols (OIDC, SAML), secrets managers, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Ability to scope and deliver complex work in ambiguous, fast-moving customer environments, making sound trade-offs between scope, speed, and quality.

  • Excellent communication skills with engineers, security and platform teams, and executive stakeholders, with a low-ego, collaborative approach and the ability to lead through influence rather than authority.

  • Proven track record of technical mentorship and of raising the bar for the engineers around you.

  • High agency and comfort operating autonomously in distributed, remote-first teams.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Travel to customer sites to build in person with customer teams, estimated at up to 50%.

Bonus

  • Experience with Docker Hardened Images, Docker Scout, MCP Gateway, MCP Toolkit, Docker Sandboxes, or Docker Model Runner.

  • Experience deploying and operating coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, or similar) in team or enterprise settings.

  • Experience with air-gapped, regulated, or compliance-driven environments in financial services, healthcare, government, or similar sectors.

  • Contributions to open source projects in the container, Kubernetes, or MCP ecosystems.

  • Prior experience founding or scaling a Forward Deployed Engineering or Professional Services practice.

Compensation & Equity

United States: €121K – €198K + equity

______________________________________________________________________

Posting Information

  • Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.

  • AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.

  • Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

______________________________________________________________________

Perks & Benefits

  • Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.

  • Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.

  • Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.

  • Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.

  • Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.

  • Learning & development – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning.

  • Parental leave – 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment.

  • Equity for all full-time employees – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow.

  • Comprehensive benefits – Medical, retirement, and paid holidays vary by country.

  • Docker swag – Because representing the whale never gets old.

Docker is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diverse teams build better products, make better decisions, and better serve our global community.

title: Deal Desk Lead
description:
Netic is the AI revenue engine for essential services who are the backbone of the American economy. With $43M in funding from Founders Fund, Greylock, Hanabi, and Dylan Field who led our Series B, we helped our customers book hundreds of thousands of jobs across services industries in North America. There are now companies operating entirely AI-first on Netic.

You’ll join our team with relentless builders from Scale, Databricks, HRT, Meta, MIT, Stanford, and Harvard in bringing frontier AI to the physical economy, where the problems are hard, the data is complex, and the impact is immediate and tangible.

The role

You'll be Netic's first Deal Desk hire. There's no approval matrix, pricing playbook or deal review process yet: you'll design all three. You'll work directly with sales leadership, Finance and our founders, and the guardrails you set will shape how every Netic deal is priced and approved.

This is a commercial analyst role. You'll model deal economics, find patterns in how we discount and win, and turn them into pricing policy that lets us say yes fast to good deals and push back on bad ones.

What you'll do

  • Build the Deal Desk from zero: the approval matrix (who approves what, at which threshold), the deal review process and the turnaround times reps can count on.

  • Review and structure non-standard deals: discounts, ramps, pilots, multi-year terms, payment terms and usage-based or per-location pricing.

  • Model deal economics at the deal and portfolio level: discount, gross margin, payback and expected expansion.

  • Analyze discounting, win rates and deal velocity by segment, deal size and rep, and recommend changes to list price, packaging and promotions with Product and leadership.

  • Partner with Finance and Legal on contract terms and revenue recognition, so what sales sells is what Finance can book.

  • Set quote and CPQ standards with Sales Ops and our Sales Systems engineer, and automate approvals as volume grows.

  • Coach AEs on deal structure for large multi-location operators and PE-backed platforms.

What success looks like in year one

  • A published approval matrix and pricing playbook, with deal reviews turned around in hours, not days.

  • Discounting and margin reported monthly, by segment and rep.

  • At least one pricing or packaging change shipped based on your analysis.

  • Approvals routed and tracked in our systems instead of Slack threads.

What you bring

  • 3+ years in deal desk, pricing, revenue operations, FP&A or a similar commercial role. Consulting or banking backgrounds welcome.

  • Strong quantitative skills and advanced Excel or Google Sheets; SQL is a plus. You're happy to build the model yourself.

  • Working knowledge of SaaS contract terms and revenue recognition basics.

  • A track record of building a process or policy from scratch and getting sales leaders to adopt it.

  • The judgment to say no with a better alternative, and the credibility to hold that line with executives.

  • A degree in economics, finance, engineering or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Salesforce CPQ, DealHub or similar quoting tools.

  • Experience pricing usage-based or AI products.

  • Experience using AI coding assistants to automate business processes or build internal tools.

Our values

  1. Obsess over the customer

  2. Every second counts

  3. Sweat the details

  4. There are no blockers

  5. Be self-directed

  6. Seek and speak the truth

  7. Enjoy the ride

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

description:

Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built.

This role serves as a recognized technical expert in desktop application architecture, driving innovation across engineering software programs and disciplines. Through technical leadership and collaboration, this individual addresses complex architectural challenges, establishes reusable engineering practices, and guides development teams in delivering scalable applications that support Divergent's computational design capabilities.

  • Lead cross-functional technical initiatives, integrating application architecture with computational design, CAE solvers, and platform capabilities.

title: Senior Product Manager, Claims Data
description:
This is a fully remote role within the United States.

As a Senior Product Manager on our Data Product team, you will own the strategy for claims data at Turquoise, from how it’s sourced and brought into the platform to how it’s used across our products. Claims data is a key input to much of what we build, and this role makes sure it’s high quality, well understood, and easy for other teams to use.

Working with claims data means working within constraints. Each source comes with its own terms, and the job is to understand them well and build as much value as possible within them. You’ll need technical depth in claims data infrastructure, a strong grasp of how claims inform pricing and reimbursement, and the judgment to handle questions that don’t have obvious answers.

What You’ll Do

Most of the time, you’ll:

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for claims data across all of our sources, deciding what to build, what to extend, and where to invest next.

  • Understand the usage terms and constraints that come with each data source, and find creative ways to build value within them.

  • Manage our external data partnerships, staying close to partners to understand their data, improve what we get from them, and keep a clear view of the broader market.

  • Own how claims data comes into Turquoise. That includes building ingestion that’s reliable and flexible across formats, and steadily improving data quality and mapping.

  • Make claims data easy for other product teams to build on, so they can move quickly without rebuilding the same logic.

  • Bring claims data into our AI and analytics experiences, so users can get answers from data that’s relevant to them.

Some of the time, you’ll:

  • Shape the in-platform experience for customers who share claims with us, so the benefit is obvious: a flexible space for building their own reports and insights from their claims.

  • Make it easy for Strategy & Operations and Solutions Engineering to access claims data for client projects and analyses.

  • Build and maintain the reusable claims dimensions and benchmarking tables that support all of the above.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • Prior product management experience (3-5 years), ideally with real ownership over a data-centric roadmap, not just data-informed decisions.

  • Direct experience with healthcare claims data and pricing mechanics, specifically how claims are adjudicated and paid against contracted rates.

  • Exposure to price transparency data specifically is a strong plus.

  • Working knowledge of how different healthcare stakeholders (payers, providers, life sciences, employers/brokers, digital health and care navigation) actually use data to make decisions. The assets you shape will serve all of them, often differently.

  • Comfort treating other internal teams as your customers, and skill at balancing proactive, self-directed roadmap work with planning built around other teams’ timelines.

  • Enough data fluency to reason clearly about data models, tradeoffs, and definitions, without needing to own or build the technical pipeline yourself.

  • A collaborative, low-ego approach to work that has enormous leverage across the org.

Benefits

  • Competitive pay with equity options

  • Stellar health care plan options (Medical, Dental & Vision), with FSA, DCFSA, & HSA options

  • Company-sponsored disability & life insurance

  • Unlimited PTO

  • 401(k) + 4% Matching

  • Fully remote work + flexible working hours

  • $750 work-from-home setup budget

  • Paid biannual in-person company summits

  • Quarterly $150 co-hanging stipend to meet up with coworkers

  • Monthly $100 health and wellness benefit

  • Generous paid family leave

  • Annual $1,200 learning & development stipend

About Turquoise Health

Turquoise Health is a Series C price transparency platform for finance leaders across healthcare. Backed by a16z, Oak HC/FT, Adams Street, Yosemite, Bessemer Venture Partners, and others, we power price transparency for 300+ enterprise organizations and are building the infrastructure for a more open, efficient healthcare marketplace. We're a remote-first, US-based team that values transparency, empathy, inclusivity, creativity, and ownership.

We operate on US business hours and work with clients entirely based in the US. For this role, we are seeking US-based candidates.

We strongly encourage BIPOC, people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ folks to apply for any open roles of interest. Healthcare affects all people differently, but it significantly affects those in underserved communities. With a robust, diverse team, we are stronger and better equipped to change the future of healthcare for all.

Work Authorization

This role requires current authorization to work in the United States. Turquoise does not sponsor employment visas (H-1B, PERM, etc.) or assume sponsorship of existing visas for this position.

Leads Netsmart’s software engineering teams to deliver high‑quality, scalable solutions by driving technical excellence, continuous improvement, and effective execution across projects, processes, and product roadmaps.

Job Summary

We are seeking a driven and experienced Engineering Manager – Java to lead and empower a team of software development professionals. In this role, you will provide strong technical leadership, foster innovation, and ensure the delivery of high-quality, scalable, and secure solutions.

This position combines hands-on technical expertise in Java technologies with people leadership and strategic execution, enabling successful delivery of complex engineering initiatives.

Key Responsibilities
Technical Leadership

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership, coaching, and guidance to software engineers.

  • Oversee the design, development, and delivery of secure, scalable, and highly available applications using Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, and modern front-end frameworks (Angular).

  • Define and drive architectural best practices including microservices, distributed systems, and cloud-native design.

  • Stay up to date with emerging Java ecosystem trends and guide technical strategy and innovation.

Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a high-performing engineering team, setting clear goals and performance expectations.

  • Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous learning.

  • Enable career growth through coaching, feedback, and skill development.

  • Balance workloads to optimize team efficiency and ensure timely delivery of high-quality solutions.

Operational Excellence

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives using metric-driven insights and engineering best practices.

  • Monitor and manage key operational metrics such as resource utilization, delivery timelines, and system performance.

  • Improve system scalability, reliability, and resiliency through proactive architecture and process improvements.

Project & Stakeholder Management

  • Lead execution of large-scale projects using Agile methodologies.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders including product, QA, and business teams.

  • Drive roadmap planning and ensure alignment with business objectives.

  • Make data-driven decisions balancing immediate deliverables and long-term strategic goals.

Budget & Resource Management

  • Plan and manage engineering budgets and resource allocation.

  • Ensure optimal utilization of engineering capacity while maintaining cost efficiency.

On-Call Responsibilities

  • Participate in a rotational on-call schedule to ensure application reliability and business continuity.

Required Qualifications

  • 12–14 years of software development experience with at least 3+ years in a leadership role.

  • Strong hands-on experience in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices Architecture.

  • Experience with full-stack development.

  • Expertise in designing and operating secure, scalable, highly available distributed systems.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred; Azure/GCP acceptable).

  • Strong database knowledge (MySQL or other relational databases

  • Solid understanding of Agile methodologies and DevOps practices

  • Strong skills in Object-Oriented Design, system design, and security principles.

  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

title: Mission Operations Master
location: BlueOps - Fort Pierce - Fort Pierce, FL 34946-7331
description:
Position Summary

Blue Ops, a Red Cat company, is seeking a highly experienced and skilled Mission Operations Master to lead the operation of autonomous surface vessels and supporting craft at our Fort Pierce, Florida, location.

This critical role combines traditional maritime command and vessel handling with the testing, evaluation, and operational deployment of advanced autonomous maritime systems. The Mission Operations Master is responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and compliant vessel operations across a variety of maritime environments while supporting mission execution, system testing, and continuous operational improvement.

Responsibilities include supervising vessel crews, monitoring vessel performance, coordinating with shoreside personnel, managing operational systems, and supporting the planning and execution of autonomous vessel missions. The successful candidate will provide experienced maritime leadership while helping advance the development and operational effectiveness of next-generation autonomous vessels.

The ideal candidate brings a strong background in maritime operations, sound judgment, exceptional problem-solving skills, and a demonstrated commitment to safety, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

1. Vessel and Mission Operations

  • Ensure the safe navigation and operation of assigned vessels, including during autonomous operations and testing.
  • Lead, supervise, and coordinate onboard personnel to maintain a professional, disciplined, and high-performing team.
  • Collaborate with shoreside teams, engineers, and mission personnel to execute test plans, operational objectives, and assigned missions.
  • Support the planning, preparation, execution, and evaluation of vessel missions designed to develop, test, and refine autonomous operating systems.
  • Monitor vessel systems, performance, and operational status; identify issues and coordinate appropriate corrective actions.
  • Maintain readiness of vessels, crews, and onboard equipment for scheduled missions and operational tasking.
  • Lead onboard safety briefings, emergency response activities, and drills to maintain a safe operating environment.
  • Maintain accurate and comprehensive logs, voyage records, maintenance documentation, and mission reports.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable U.S. Coast Guard (USCG), International Maritime Organization (IMO), Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS), and relevant classification society requirements, as applicable to the vessel and operation.

2. External Coordination and Maritime Compliance

  • Coordinate with port control, port authorities, the U.S. Coast Guard, pilot associations, and other maritime stakeholders to secure required access, approvals, and operational support.
  • Manage vessel movements, berthing assignments, fueling, provisioning, and dockside logistics in accordance with mission schedules.
  • Maintain effective communication with regulatory authorities and external service providers to support compliant and efficient operations.
  • Serve as the primary maritime point of contact for field operations involving port infrastructure, vessel support services, and external maritime stakeholders.
  • Support vessel inspections, regulatory reviews, and operational readiness assessments.
  • Ensure required vessel documentation, certifications, and operational records remain current and readily available.

3. Safety, Navigation, and Operational Readiness

  • Apply sound maritime judgment and maintain situational awareness in changing weather, traffic, and navigational conditions.
  • Interpret nautical charts, weather forecasts, navigational data, and other relevant information to support voyage planning and mission execution.
  • Apply the International Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea (COLREGs) and applicable navigation rules.
  • Conduct risk assessments and implement appropriate mitigation measures before and during vessel operations.
  • Ensure emergency procedures, communications protocols, and safety equipment are understood, available, and operational.
  • Support the identification and resolution of operational deficiencies and contribute to continuous improvement in vessel procedures and mission execution.

Required Qualifications

  • Valid U.S. Coast Guard (USCG) Master license appropriate to the vessel, route, and assigned duties.
  • Required STCW credentials, including Basic Training, Officer in Charge of a Navigational Watch (OICNW), Medical Person in Charge (Medical PIC), and Federal Communications Commission (FCC) license, as applicable to the position.
  • Current Transportation Worker Identification Credential (TWIC).
  • Valid USCG/STCW medical certificate and valid passport.
  • Demonstrated experience serving in a senior deck officer or command role aboard crewed vessels in dynamic maritime environments.
  • Strong knowledge of marine navigation, ship handling, voyage planning, bridge resource management, and shipboard emergency procedures.
  • Working knowledge of USCG requirements, applicable SOLAS provisions, classification society requirements, and international maritime regulations.
  • Experience interpreting nautical charts, weather forecasts, navigational data, and maritime traffic information.
  • Proficiency with voyage-planning software, GIS tools, and marine navigation systems.
  • Ability to maintain accurate operational logs, maintenance records, inspection documentation, and compliance records.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and decision-making skills, particularly in time-sensitive or high-pressure environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across operational, technical, and leadership teams.
  • Ability to stand a 12-hour navigational watch.
  • Ability to successfully complete required background screening and USCG/DOT drug testing.
  • Eligibility to obtain a security clearance is preferred for assignments involving restricted or government-access facilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Extensive experience holding a USCG Master license and commanding or operating vessels in complex maritime environments.
  • Familiarity with the handling and maneuvering characteristics of jet-drive-propelled vessels.
  • Experience operating, testing, or supporting autonomous or unmanned maritime systems.
  • Experience supporting research, development, testing, and evaluation (RDT&E) activities.
  • Previous experience supporting the Department of Defense (DoD), U.S. government agencies, or government-contracted maritime programs.
  • Experience coordinating vessel operations with engineering, software, and systems-integration teams.

Role Requirements and Competencies

  • Demonstrated success in a shipboard leadership or vessel command role.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple operational priorities simultaneously.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with crew members, technical personnel, external stakeholders, and senior leadership.
  • A proactive approach to problem-solving, operational risk management, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong leadership skills, including the ability to establish expectations, develop personnel, and maintain accountability.
  • Flexibility to support evolving mission requirements, operational schedules, and field assignments.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% as operational needs require.
  • Availability to work a projected 28-days-on / 28-days-off rotation.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

The Mission Operations Master must be able to perform the essential functions of the position in a dynamic marine environment.

  • Meet applicable fitness-for-duty requirements, including the ability to swim and tread water.
  • Frequently lift, push, pull, and carry objects weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Work outdoors in marine conditions, including direct sunlight, wind, rain, cold, and saltwater spray.
  • Operate vessels and navigation systems during daylight, low-light, and nighttime conditions.
  • Perform physically demanding tasks involving stooping, bending, reaching, squatting, kneeling, crouching, twisting, and crawling.
  • Climb ladders and access elevated structures while maintaining balance and following required safety procedures.
  • Stand and walk for extended periods on vessel decks and uneven surfaces.
  • Work in hot and humid conditions while following established heat-stress prevention and hydration procedures.
  • Maintain sufficient hearing to detect alarms, communications, and verbal safety instructions.
  • Wear required personal protective equipment (PPE), including safety glasses, safety footwear, and hard hats, as appropriate to the task.

About Blue Ops

Blue Ops, a Red Cat company, supports the advancement of autonomous maritime capabilities through skilled personnel, operational expertise, and the integration of emerging technologies. Our mission operations team helps bridge traditional maritime expertise and next-generation autonomous vessel systems to deliver safe, reliable, and effective maritime capabilities.

Background Check

This position will require successfully completing a post-offer background check. Qualified candidates with a criminal history will be considered and are not automatically disqualified, consistent with federal and state law.

EEO and ITAR/EAR Work Authorization Disclosure

Red Cat Holdings provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software, technology or technical data controlled under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). Successful candidates for positions subject to ITAR/EAR restrictions must provide proof of U.S. Citizenship or Permanent Residence and must not require sponsorship for export-restricted work authorization.

E-Verify

The company participates E-Verify ensure eligibility for employment and compliance with Right to Work rules.

Compensation: Salary plus generous annual equity package and potential bonuses.

title: NPI engineer
description:
ABOUT THE JOB

We’re looking for a hands-on NPI Engineer to be the technical bridge between Engineering and Manufacturing as Arxlight’s drone products move from development into production.

This role sits within the Operations organization but works closely with the engineering team throughout the product development cycle. You’ll become a subject matter expert on the product, understand the mechanical design at a system and component level, and make sure it can be built reliably and efficiently at scale.

The focus of this role is the product and its design, not the manufacturing process itself. You’ll drive DFM and DFA, identify design issues before they become production problems, and make sure Engineering and Manufacturing stay aligned as the product evolves.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own the technical transition of new products from Engineering into Manufacturing, from early prototypes through NPI builds and production ramp.

  • Become a subject matter expert on the product, with a deep understanding of its mechanical design, assemblies, interfaces, materials, tolerances, BOM, and critical-to-quality features.

  • Drive DFM and DFA reviews, working with Engineering to improve part design, tolerancing, assembly, material selection, manufacturing methods, cost, and scalability.

  • Design and develop production tooling, fixtures, jigs, gauges, and other equipment needed to build, inspect, and test the product consistently.

  • Lead technical issues during NPI builds, working across Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and suppliers to troubleshoot failures, determine root cause, and drive design changes when needed.

  • Own product-level manufacturing readiness, including BOM maturity, drawings, GD&T, specifications, assembly requirements, tooling, configuration, and engineering change implementation.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience in NPI, mechanical engineering, product engineering, manufacturing engineering, or a similar role supporting complex hardware products.

  • Strong mechanical engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience with mechanical design, materials, tolerances, GD&T, fastening, adhesives, and electromechanical assemblies.

  • Strong understanding of DFM/DFA and experience influencing mechanical designs to improve manufacturability, assembly, quality, cost, and scalability.

  • Experience designing or developing tooling, fixtures, jigs, gauges, and other mechanical solutions used to build or inspect production hardware.

  • Experience with manufacturing processes such as CNC machining, injection molding, sheet metal, die casting, 3D printing, composites, and production assembly.

  • Experience taking complex hardware from prototype through EVT/DVT/PVT, NPI, and production ramp, with strong hands-on troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with drones, robotics, aerospace, autonomous systems, or other complex electromechanical products.

  • Strong CAD experience and the ability to create and review mechanical designs, drawings, tolerance stack-ups, GD&T, tooling, and assembly interfaces.

  • Experience working directly with machine shops, contract manufacturers, injection molders, and other mechanical suppliers during development and production ramp.

  • Experience designing fixtures and tooling for assembly, calibration, inspection, testing, or production processes.

  • Experience with PLM systems, BOMs, drawings, specifications, ECOs, deviations, and hardware configuration management.

  • Experience in a startup or fast-moving hardware environment where you’re comfortable moving between CAD, the engineering lab, the production floor, and suppliers to get problems solved.

title: Security Engineer, Detection & Response
description:
About Thinking Machines

The mission of Thinking Machines is to build AI that extends human will and judgment. We are training frontier models with Inkling, developing Tinker to let people make models their own, and crafting interfaces that broaden human-AI communication. We believe the future worth building is human, and we're hiring people who want to build it.

About the Role

We’re looking for a detection and response engineer to build how we find, investigate, and stop threats against our company, platforms, models, and data. You’ll own the pipelines that turn raw telemetry into high-fidelity detections, lead the response when real incidents happen, and run a threat intelligence practice that keeps our defenses focused on the adversaries who actually target frontier AI labs. You’ll partner closely with security, infrastructure, research, and product teams so that detection and response scale with the company instead of slowing it down.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead incident response end-to-end: triage, scoping, containment, eradication, recovery, and blameless postmortems that turn lessons into new detections and controls.

  • Design, build, and operate the security data pipelines and tooling that power detection and response: collecting, normalizing, enriching, and storing telemetry from cloud, Kubernetes, identity, endpoint, SaaS, and application sources.

  • Author, deploy, and maintain high-fidelity detections across SIEM, endpoint, cloud, and security tooling

  • Build and run our threat intelligence practice: track actors and campaigns relevant to AI labs such as espionage, model weight theft, supply chain compromise, and credential abuse. Turn that intel into hunts, detections, and hardening recommendations.

  • Proactively hunt for threats across our environment, and build automation and response tooling: enrichment, playbooks, automated containment that shortens time to detect and respond.

  • Collaborate with researchers and product teams to detect AI-specific threats in production.Develop and exercise incident response plans, on-call processes, and tabletop exercises with engineering, research, legal, and leadership.

  • Participate in an on-call pager rotation for security incidents.

Skills and Qualifications

Minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in computer science, engineering, or similar.

  • Proficiency in Python or Rust for building data pipelines, detections, and internal tools.

  • A track record responding to real security incidents in production environments, including leading investigations and coordinating across teams under pressure.

  • Hands-on experience building and operating security data pipelines at scale: log ingestion, parsing and normalization, enrichment, and storage and query in a SIEM or data lake (e.g., Splunk, Elastic, Panther, BigQuery, Snowflake, or ClickHouse).

  • Experience producing and consuming threat intelligence: tracking adversary TTPs, mapping them to frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK, and translating intel into detections and hunts.

  • Strong understanding of cloud, AWS, GCP, or Azure, Kubernetes, and identity provider telemetry, and how attackers move through these environments.

  • Familiarity with host and network forensics, including endpoint telemetry, memory and disk analysis, and network logs.

  • Comfort operating across the stack and owning projects end-to-end.

  • Clear communication: incident reports, intel briefs, and postmortems for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred qualifications

  • Detection and response experience at an AI lab, cloud provider, or other high-threat environment targeted by sophisticated actors.

  • Experience detecting AI-specific abuse, such as prompt injection, model extraction, or anomalous API usage.

  • Familiarity with ML infrastructure telemetry: GPU clusters, training jobs, and model artifact storage.

  • Experience with stream processing (e.g., Kafka, Flink, Vector) and cost-aware log management at high volume.

  • Malware analysis or reverse engineering experience.

  • Talks, blogs, open-source detection content, or published threat research.

Logistics

  • Location: This role is based in San Francisco, California.

  • Compensation: Depending on background, skills and experience, the expected annual salary range for this position is $300,000 - $350,000 USD.

  • Visa sponsorship: We sponsor visas. While we can't guarantee success for every candidate or role, if you're the right fit, we're committed to working through the visa process together.

  • Benefits: Thinking Machines offers generous health, dental, and vision benefits, unlimited PTO, paid parental leave, and relocation support as needed.

title: Software Engineer, Data
description:
You are a builder who would rather fix the system than fix the same ticket twice. Generate's Data & Technology team runs the data platform the whole firm depends on, and we are increasingly replacing SaaS tools, spreadsheets, and manual processes with software we build ourselves. This role sits at the center of both: keeping our data pipelines healthy today and helping build the tools that come next. You're comfortable debugging code you didn't write, you enjoy working directly with the people who use what you build, and AI agents are already central to how you work.

What you will be doing at Generate Capital as a Software Engineer, Data:

  • Own the day-to-day health of our data pipelines: Python ETL jobs, dbt models in Snowflake, Azure Data Factory pipelines, and the reports and system integrations that depend on them.

  • Triage failures to root cause and fix them, from vendor schema changes and API rate limits to failed model tests and broken dependencies.

  • Work directly with stakeholders across the business to understand the impact of an issue, keep them informed, and confirm the resolution actually solved their problem.

  • Collaborate with the data team on fixes, code reviews, and releases.

  • Treat every recurring ticket as a design problem, adding the alerting, validation, retries, and schema-change handling that stop a whole class of failure from coming back.

  • Proactively find weaknesses in process, architecture, code quality, and security before they break, and drive the fix.

  • Help define and enforce repeatable patterns for quality and security across deployment, logging, testing, and secrets handling.

  • Help build, ship, and run internal applications that replace SaaS vendors, spreadsheets, and manual processes.

  • Sit with business stakeholders, translate their problems into requirements and prototypes, and turn those into working software.

  • Use AI coding agents as your default way of working, and share your workflows and tooling so the whole team gets faster.

Candidate qualifications & core characteristics:

  • A demonstrated passion for, or commitment to, our mission.

  • 2–3 years of professional software or data engineering experience. Exceptional new graduates with substantial shipped work will be considered.

  • Strong Python and SQL.

  • Experience building or operating software in a cloud environment. Azure is preferred; AWS or GCP experience is welcome.

  • AI coding agents are already central to how you work, and you can walk us through your workflow in detail.

  • Comfort debugging systems you didn't build, under time pressure, with incomplete information.

  • Ability to translate business problems into technical solutions.

  • Experience with Snowflake and dbt is a plus.

  • Experience building internal tools or full-stack applications is a plus.

  • Experience in financial services, energy, or another data-heavy environment is advantageous.

  • Unimpeachable integrity and glowing references.

  • Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, including empathy, intuition, and listening as well as strong writing and documentation skills.

  • High level of self-awareness and humility, with excitement about confronting uncomfortable situations or new challenges.

  • Intellectual agility, curiosity, and creativity; problem-solving is your default mode.

  • Entrepreneurial spirit: flexibility, comfort with risk, recognition that “perfect can be the enemy of the good”.

This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, CA.

Salary decisions take into account a wide variety of factors including, but not limited to: skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, geographic location, and other business and organizational needs.
