title: Senior/ Staff Product Engineer (Full Stack)
description:
Senior/ Staff Product Engineer (Full Stack)

Location: New York, NY (on-site, 4 days a week)
Compensation: $225,000–$325,000 base salary + meaningful equity
Employment: Full-time
Department: Engineering

Note: We are hiring at Senior and Staff levels. Final compensation depends on level, based on your demonstrated experience, scope of ownership, and impact.

About Revin

Revin builds AI-powered software for the businesses that keep our homes running: roofing, HVAC, plumbing, remodeling, and more. We help these businesses respond to customers, book appointments, and manage the customer experience across voice, SMS, and email.

Revin handles around half a million customer conversations a month. Businesses with hundreds of millions in annual revenue rely on our products for work that directly affects their customers and their bottom line.

Our customers include Vertex Service Partners, a national roofing and exterior-services platform with over $600M in revenue, and Del-Air, a $300M+ HVAC and plumbing business.

See the impact of our work: we’ve helped Del-Air book 11,000+ membership appointments, while ImproveIt uses Revin to set 34% of its booked appointments.

We’re still early, with substantial room to shape the product, the team, and the business. You’ll join a small team of sharp, ambitious people and receive meaningful equity ownership in the company you’re helping build.

The Role

We’re looking for a strong engineer who combines technical ability with product judgment, curiosity about customers, and an eye for good user experience.

You’ll partner closely with our product manager to decide what we build and how we build it. One PM oversees our entire product, so engineers have substantial responsibility for shaping solutions, challenging assumptions, and influencing the roadmap. We work from clear product briefs and give engineers the independence to make decisions and carry them through.

You’ll own customer-facing product work from the initial problem through launch and iteration. Success means customers adopt what you build, it makes their work better, and you can demonstrate that through usage and outcomes.

We use AI programming tools heavily. You should be excited about how much a capable generalist can accomplish with these tools and bring the judgment to deliver high-quality results.

What you’ll build

  • A unified messaging workspace. A single place where customer service teams see voice, SMS, and email communication and handle agent escalations.

  • Embedded booking experiences. Interfaces that let customers schedule appointments directly on a service provider’s website.

  • Agent management tools. Experiences that help operators maintain and improve how their AI agents work.

  • Reporting and analytics. Products that help customers understand interaction outcomes, assess quality, and identify opportunities to improve.

  • Revin’s API and MCP interfaces. Developer interfaces that enable other software and AI agents to work with our platform.

What you’ll do

  • Own products and features end to end. Understand the customer problem, shape the solution, build across the interface, APIs, and data layer, and improve it after launch.

  • Help shape our roadmap. Bring ideas and informed opinions. Work with product to weigh customer value against technical complexity, timelines, cost, and reliability.

  • Build thoughtful customer experiences. Create intuitive, polished interfaces in TypeScript and React, including the details that make complex workflows feel simple.

  • Measure adoption and impact. Define success metrics, build the instrumentation to track them, and use data and customer feedback to decide what to improve next.

  • Keep work moving. Ship in short iteration cycles, surface blockers early, and advance other priorities while dependencies are resolved.

  • Raise the quality of our execution. Communicate tradeoffs clearly, use AI tools effectively, and take responsibility for testing, debugging, and the reliability of what you ship.

  • At Staff level, you’ll also help set direction across product areas and raise the effectiveness of the broader engineering team while remaining hands-on.

What you’ll bring

  • Substantial experience building products for external customers. You can walk us through products you owned, the decisions you made, what you learned from users, and how the product improved.

  • Fluency in TypeScript and React. You can follow a feature across the stack and learn unfamiliar systems.

  • Strong product judgment. You understand the business problem behind a request, question assumptions, and make sensible decisions when the answer isn’t fully specified. You bring opinions and adapt them as you learn.

  • Good instincts for user experience. You care about how a product feels and work closely with product and design to make it better.

  • Experience measuring what happens after launch. You’ve used instrumentation, adoption metrics, or experimentation to understand whether your work delivered value.

  • Independence and clear communication. You take initiative, make progress through ambiguity, and keep collaborators informed about decisions, risks, and changing expectations.

  • A desire to work in an early-stage startup. You’re energized by broad responsibility, rapid iteration, and the opportunity to make substantial improvements quickly.

Nice to have

  • Experience building products at a strong startup.

  • Experience with Python or PostgreSQL.

  • Experience shipping AI-powered products or production agents.

Compensation and benefits

  • $225,000–$325,000 base salary

  • Meaningful early equity. A real ownership stake and the opportunity to share substantially in the upside you help create

  • Excellent health coverage. $0 employee premiums for individual medical coverage on most plans, plus dental and vision insurance

  • 401(k) matching up to 4% of salary. Revin matches 100% of the first 3% you contribute, then 50% of the next 2%. Contribute 5% to receive the full match

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Commuter benefits

  • Free lunches and dinners in the office

  • $100/month gym membership stipend

  • Tech equipment of your choice

  • Four days together in Flatiron, one remote day, and flexibility when things come up

title: Development Expert
description:
Job Description

What you’ll build

As part of the Industry AI unit for Energy and Natural Resources, your focus will be on the architecture, design, and technical delivery of solutions and agents in the area of metering concept management/distributed energy resources. Working side by side with a steadfast team of Product Experts who define the scope, you will translate product requirements into scalable, cloud-native software architectures and guide your development team from design to production.

You will own the end-to-end technical solution and new agentic use cases, ensuring that system design decisions balance correctness, performance, and maintainability. You drive architectural governance, evaluate technology choices, and act as the primary technical point of contact for all development teams on a day-to-day basis.

Direct involvement with customers on technical requirements and solution design is an important and integral part of your work.

This role requires a combination of deep technical expertise, systems thinking, and proficient communication skills in English.

Required skills & experiences:

· Design and deliver software solutions for utility customers.

· Translate product requirements and regulatory changes into concrete technical designs, implementation plans, and actionable engineering tasks.

· You have a exemplary knowledge of Agentic AI, SAP Business AI, and modern AI engineering capabilities, including their useful application in industry-specific technical architectures.

· You have a exemplary knowledge of governance, security, compliance, and data and privacy considerations is essential. Proven experience optimizing complex, high-throughput systems for performance and cost efficiency is expected

· You have demonstrated the ability to lead and mentor development teams, set architectural direction, and align cross-functional stakeholders on technical trade-offs and delivery priorities.

· You're also a technical leader who can mentor engineers, guide design decisions, and influence cross-functional stakeholders across product, platform, and AI teams. Solid consulting and results orientation with the ability to structure technical ambiguity, evaluate architectural options, and guide teams from initial design to validated implementation.

· You have proactively uses AI in daily engineering workflows to accelerate design, code reviews, testing, automation, and quality assurance of results.

· Excellent knowledge of English.

What you bring

· You have several years of hands-on experience in software architecture and development, ideally in the utilities or energy industry.

· You have a deep knowledge of the technical landscape — from message exchange to smart meter gateway integration — and you stay informed about relevant regulatory and technology trends.

· Based on your architectural expertise, your knowledge of cloud-native patterns, and your solid analytical skills, you design solutions that are both technically sound and valuable to customers.

Where you belong

You will be part of the Industry AI unit for Energy and Natural Resources, a team focused on turning Industry AI opportunities in the ENR space into measurable customer value.

In this role, you’ll help raise engineering standards beyond your immediate responsibility by spearheading architectural best practices, fostering an AI-powered development culture, and enabling your team to deliver with confidence and momentum.

If you want to shape the technical foundation of solutions that run critical energy infrastructure and are ready to take Industry AI for ENR from architecture to AI-supported implementation, this role is a great fit for you.

Key competencies in this role include agentic engineering, agentic orchestration, AI-assisted engineering, cloud architecture, cloud security architecture, CI/CD, evaluation and benchmark engineering, scalability design, semantic retrieval, systems thinking, and technical executive team. In addition, you have experience in the daily use of agentic AI as well as in promoting AI adoption in engineering organizations.

Other skills used in this role: Collaboration, Complex Problem Solving, Creative Thinking, Effective Communication, Learning Agility, Agentic AI Day-to-Day Practice, AI Adoption Capability, AI Output Quality Assurance, Context Engineering, AI-Assisted Automation and Prototyping,Observability, AI-Assisted Engineering, Troubleshooting (Problem Solving),Cloud Architecture, Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

title: Program Educator (must hold EMT-B licensure)
location: Medic One Corporate Office, Jonesboro, AR, US
description:
The EMS Program Educator is responsible for delivering high-quality Emergency Medical Services education programs, including Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) and Advanced EMT (AEMT) courses in accordance with the Arkansas Department of Health Office of EMS regulations and National EMS Education Standards.

This position is designed for an exceptional educator and clinician who is passionate about developing competent, compassionate EMS professionals. The Program Educator will lead classroom, laboratory, simulation, and clinical education while fostering critical thinking, clinical excellence, and professional behavior among students entering the EMS workforce.

The ideal candidate is a dynamic instructor with strong teaching ability, a deep understanding of prehospital medicine, and a commitment to educational excellence and student success.


Role and Responsibilities

  • Serve as primary or adjunct instructor for EMT and Advanced EMT courses in accordance with Arkansas EMS regulations.
  • Deliver engaging classroom lectures, hands-on skills labs, scenario-based simulations, and clinical preparation aligned with the National Registry.
  • Design and implement effective educational strategies, including simulation, case-based learning, and competency-based assessment.
  • Develop lesson plans, instructional materials, and course assessments that meet Arkansas Department of Health EMS program requirements.
  • Ensure all EMS education courses receive appropriate approval from the Arkansas Office of EMS prior to course delivery.
  • Coordinate and monitor clinical and field internship experiences with hospitals and EMS agencies.
  • Evaluate student performance using written exams, psychomotor testing, and scenario-based assessments.
  • Provide constructive feedback and mentorship to support student success, professional growth, and clinical competence.
  • Maintain accurate records of student progress, attendance, clinical hours, and competency evaluations.
  • Ensure students meet all course completion requirements necessary to challenge the National Registry of EMTs (NREMT) certification examination.
  • Collaborate with the Education Director, Medical Director, and EMS leadership to maintain accreditation and regulatory compliance.
  • Participate in continuous program quality improvement and curriculum development.
  • Promote professionalism, patient safety, ethical practice, and evidence-based EMS care.
  • Represent the program during community outreach, recruitment events, and EMS continuing education programs.

Qualifications and Education Requirements

  • Current Arkansas EMS provider license at the EMT or higher level
  • Current Arkansas EMS Instructor certification preferred
  • Minimum two (2) years continuous experience as an EMS provider prior to instructor certification preferred
  • Successful completion of an Arkansas Office of EMS approved 40-hour EMT Instructor Course or ability to receive in 30 days from hire.
  • Current Basic Life Support (BLS) Instructor certification through American Heart Association or ability to receive in 30 days from hire.
  • Ability to function as a primary instructor for EMT programs and instructor at AEMT level or higher for AEMT programs as required by Arkansas EMS rules, or ability to receive30 days from hire.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to teach adult learners using evidence-based educational methods
  • Demonstrate a strong commitment to workplace safety by identifying hazards, reporting risks, and supporting continuous safety improvements.
  • Adhere to all company safety policies, procedures and regulatory requirements while actively promoting a safe and compliant work environment.
  • Collaborate with team members to upload safety standards and foster a culture of safety across all operations.


Strong organizational and documentation skills

  • Graduation From High School or equivalent
  • 19 years old or older at time of hire for insurance purposes
  • Valid Driver’s license
  • Ability to drive company vehicles with a clean driving record.
  • Availability for recall in times of crisis
  • Ability to pass a lift test of 150 – 200 pounds.
  • Ability to pass a pre-employment drug test.
  • Ability to pass a pre-employment background check.
  • Ability to speak, read, and write English.

Working Conditions

  • Periodic clinical site visits and field internship supervision
  • Occasional evening or weekend instruction depending on course schedule
  • Frequent standing, movement during practical skills labs, and simulation instruction
  • Possible travel to partner hospitals, EMS agencies, or training sites

Preferred Skills

  • Prior experience teaching EMT or AEMT courses at an accredited EMS training program
  • Strong adult education and instructional design skills
  • Experience with simulation-based training and scenario development
  • Ability to engage diverse learners and foster critical thinking
  • Experience mentoring new EMS providers or precepting students
  • Current instructor credentials such as:
    • ACLS Instructor
    • PALS Instructor
    • ITLS / PHTLS Instructor
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in EMS, education, healthcare, or related field
  • Strong commitment to student success, patient care excellence, and professional development
  • Ability to create a high-performance learning environment that produces confident, competent EMS clinicians

title: Sr. Manager, Software Engineering - Computer Backup
description:
About Backblaze

Backblaze provides reliable, high-availability cloud storage and backup trusted by consumers, SMBs, enterprises, and developers in over 150 countries. Backblaze Computer Backup protects the data of hundreds of thousands of customers, backing up laptops and desktops across Windows and macOS to the Backblaze cloud. We build durable, scalable systems with a strong emphasis on reliability, product quality, and a great customer experience.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Manager to lead the team responsible for Backblaze Computer Backup, spanning both the cross-platform desktop client and the backend services that receive, store, and restore customer data. The entire Computer Backup engineering team reports into this role, which you will run through Desktop and Backend Leads who own the day-to-day of their areas. You will set the long-term technical direction for the product, own its multi-quarter delivery strategy, and hold accountability for the team’s budget and results.

This is a hands-on management role. You will take part in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical decisions across both the desktop and backend sides of the product, while also owning strategy, budget, and the growth of your staff. The right candidate brings strong experience running agile teams, experience managing managers or team leads, deep expertise in system architecture, and a track record of leading distributed, remote-first engineering teams. You bring 7+ years of engineering management experience and enthusiasm for how AI-assisted development is changing the way software gets built.

What You'll Be Doing
  • Lead the full Computer Backup engineering team, which reports into this role, with Desktop and Backend Leads running the day-to-day of their areas.
  • Set the long-term technical direction for Computer Backup, ensuring architecture and platform decisions hold up as the product and customer base grow.
  • Own the multi-quarter delivery strategy for Computer Backup, and partner with Product leadership to help set the roadmap and negotiate scope, schedule, and priorities.
  • Hold accountability for the team’s budget and spend, aligning headcount, tooling, and infrastructure investment with business priorities.
  • Make technical and organizational decisions with broad, long-term impact, including shared platform components and infrastructure that other teams depend on.
  • Ensure the desktop and backend areas operate well together, with shared goals and a consistent agile delivery process.
  • Provide oversight of the team’s agile process, ensuring ceremonies such as sprint planning, backlog refinement, standups, and retrospectives are run well and consistently across both areas.

  • 7+ years of engineering management experience, including managing managers or team leads, ideally in a cloud, SaaS, desktop software, or platform engineering environment.

title: Principal Product Manager, Agentic Commerce
description:
Company

Alaska Airlines
The Team

Guided by our purpose, core values, and leadership principles, we are creating an airline people love. Our corporate teams set the strategies and operational plans to ensure the success of our company. Whether we use our expertise in accounting, human resources, finance, planning, legal, marketing, or any of our operational divisions, our shared passion for travel and our guests is what motivates us to achieve excellence each day. If you share our passion for creating an airline people love, we want to hear from you.


Role Summary

The Principal Product Manager is a lead subject matter expert responsible for crafting the vision and backlog(s) for an assigned product area. As an individual contributor, this role presents options for the long-term strategy for a product portfolio to key stakeholders and exercises considerable latitude and initiative to solve complex problems. This role will work closely with business stakeholders, designers, and engineers to design, implement, test, and refine functionality for digital experiences. The Principal Product Manager also acts as a mentor to teammates and provides thought leadership for Alaska Air Group (AAG).


Key Duties

  • Responsible for the creation, communicates, and regularly updates a vision and direction for their product portfolio.
  • Responsible for the creation, decisions, and maintenance of a value-based prioritized backlog of opportunities for products which align to Alaska’s business strategy and goals.
  • Responsible for the creation, communication, and maintenance of strategic roadmaps to ensure visibility and transparency of work planned.
  • Use product discovery techniques to move from idea to prototype.
  • Accountable for the creation of user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Utilize story mapping techniques to inform the creation of release plans, with a strong bias towards incremental delivery and iteration.
  • Partner with the UX Design & Engineering teams to provide guidance and prioritization during the product development process and participate in user research and product discovery activities
  • Exercise considerable judgment to make key tradeoff decisions.
  • Engage in constructive conversations with - and deliver tough messages when needed - to key stakeholders, including senior executives, while continually building professional and productive relationships.
  • Coordinates new & changed functionality with affected groups to ensure seamless rollout of new capabilities.
  • Interacts with external vendors in design, delivery and support of software and hardware products.
  • Develops and reports on key product development metrics and builds ability to track and measure into offerings.
  • Provides day to day support of the portfolio of applications and products including managing support inquiries, responding to user feedback, creating communications, triaging reported system issues and identifying timeline for resolution as part of Agile Delivery Sprint processes, etc.
  • Builds and establishes partnerships with external vendors and partners to achieve outcomes to support the operation and product(s).

Additional Details

This product role will focus on shaping how Alaska Airlines shows up in an increasingly agent-driven world. You’ll define the strategy for how AI agents discover, understand, and interact with Alaska across the guest journey, while owning the business outcomes of this emerging channel. You’ll focus on understanding demand, optimizing commercial performance, and experimenting with new ways to drive value, ultimately enabling secure, seamless experiences where an agent can help a guest go from searching for a flight to completing transactions or managing their trip. You’ll build on early AI work already underway, partnering closely with engineering and cross-functional teams to determine what we build next and how we scale Agentic Commerce.


Job-Specific Experience, Education & Skills

Required

  • 7 years of experience in product management and/or technology or related area.
  • Bachelor’s degree with a focus in a related discipline, or an additional two years of training/experience in lieu of this degree.
  • Proficiency with product management methodologies (including user research and product discovery).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with diverse audiences, including both technical and non-technical customers, colleagues, and executives.
  • Ability to facilitate user group meetings with stakeholders and drive agenda for a common solution.
  • Proficiency with AGILE/SCRUM software development methodology.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the software development life cycle (SDLC).
  • Demonstrated ability to interact with all levels of management cross-divisionally.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects with increased complexity.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage conflict.
  • High school diploma or equivalent is required.
  • Minimum age of 18.
  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S.

Preferred

  • Prior product management experience with a team developing mobile applications for iOS devices.
  • Prior airline industry experience.
  • Experience managing vendor relationships.

Embody our values to own safety, do the right thing, be caring and kind, and deliver performance.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (C# and Angular)
description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department OverviewWelcome to Motorola Solutions. By applying for this role, you will become a founding technical member of the new CC Insights team. Our hybrid team—spanning the US and South Africa—is building a unified reporting application that combines various reporting products acquired and built in-house over the past few years. We aim to deliver a seamless analytics experience featuring embedded PowerBI reports and an innovative AI-assisted workflow that empowers users to chat with their data.
This product sits on a robust data foundation powered by our internal Data Platform (BDP), leveraging Databricks and Azure Data Lake for our Bronze and Silver data layers. The new Insights team owns the Gold layer (Synapse via Databricks) and the unified web application.
You will be joining a highly collaborative group of Data and Software Engineers, while working closely with the Data Platform Engineering (DPE) team.
Job Description

We are looking for a FullStack Engineer to join our team. Your primary responsibilities will be to design and develop services and components on this stack, and to coordinate with the rest of the team working on different layers of the infrastructure.

You will drive the development of our C# backend and Angular frontend, integrate PowerBI via the Embedded SDK, and architect scalable, multi-tenant microservices. You will also play a key role in migrating functionalities from various other reporting products into our unified frontend. A commitment to collaborative problem solving, sophisticated design, and a thirst for elegant code is a must.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build the Foundation: Develop and maintain the unified CC Insights web app, integrating embedded PowerBI reports via the Angular SDK and facilitating AI-assisted workflows.

  • Architectural Stewardship: Work within a layered architecture spanning controllers, services, repositories, and data-access components, while improving boundaries where they are weak or overly coupled.

  • Legacy Migration: Evaluate and migrate features from various reporting products into Insights, requiring code analysis of existing systems.

  • Data & Multi-Tenancy: Develop and optimize multi-tenant data access patterns using EF Core, SQL Server, and tenant-aware access controls.

  • Platform Capabilities: Build and maintain cross-cutting platform capabilities including authentication, authorization, feature flags, observability, metrics, logging, exception handling, and resiliency policies.

  • Frontend Engineering: Contribute to frontend state management patterns using Angular and centralized state tools such as NgRx.

  • Technical Leadership: Lead technical design and code reviews, identify architectural risks early, and drive pragmatic improvements rather than cosmetic rewrites.

  • Operational Excellence: Debug production issues across application, infrastructure, and data layers using logs, traces, and metrics. Partner with product, QA, DevOps, and other engineers to deliver features with clear operational ownership.

  • DevOps & Pipeline Automation: Design, build, and manage robust CI/CD pipelines utilizing GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps (ADO) to ensure seamless continuous integration, automated testing, and reliable deployment of our C# backend and Angular frontend services.

  • Mentorship: Mentor other engineers through design guidance, code review, and engineering standards.


Basic Requirements

  • Core Backend Skills: Proficient in C#, with a good knowledge of its ecosystems. Familiarity with the .NET framework as well as .Net Core, alongside a strong understanding of object-oriented programming.

  • Frontend Expertise: Experience with Angular or a comparable modern frontend framework, plus familiarity with frontend state management patterns.

  • AI Coding Proficiency: Highly proficient in utilizing modern AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to accelerate development, aid in code comprehension, and improve overall code quality.

  • System Architecture: Experience working in layered or modular monolith architectures with dependency injection and interface-driven design. Ability to make sound architectural decisions in an existing codebase without defaulting to unnecessary rewrites.

  • Multi-Tenant Systems: Experience building or maintaining multi-tenant systems, including data isolation and tenant-aware authorization patterns.

  • Reliability & Observability: Experience with distributed-system reliability practices (retries, circuit breakers, timeouts, defensive error handling) and observability tooling (structured logging, metrics, tracing, production diagnostics).

  • CI/CD Pipeline Development: Hands-on experience building, configuring, and managing CI/CD pipelines from scratch. Strong proficiency with GitHub Actions, GitHub Repositories, and Azure DevOps (ADO) for automated builds, testing, and release management.

  • Collaboration: Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders.

  • Design Patterns: Familiarity with various design and architectural patterns. Familiarity with Domain Driven Design and Event Sourcing would be advantageous

  • Unit Testing: Experience in writing unit tests to ensure code quality.

Beneficial Skills

  • Knowledge of PySpark and SQL to better collaborate on the Databricks/Synapse data pipelines.

  • Prior experience with LLM integrations (e.g., OpenAI, LangChain, Azure AI) to support chat-assisted workflows.

  • Complete understanding of React and its main fundamentals.

In return for your expertise, we’ll support you in this new challenge with coaching & development every step of the way. Also, to reward your hard work, you’ll get:

  • PTO 20 Days

  • Life Cover - Life, dread disease, salary protection - this is covered in full by RD and not out of CTC.

  • Fully Remote (within South Africa) - we will set you up to work from home with a laptop and necessary accessories.

Relocation ProvidedNone
Position TypeExperienced

Referral Payment PlanYes

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

title: Clinical Compliance Coordinator

Join Our Team!

Greater Vision Healthcare Services is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Clinical Compliance Coordinator to support our clinical compliance, quality assurance, and regulatory oversight initiatives.

This position plays an essential role in ensuring our healthcare operations maintain compliance with applicable federal, state, and local regulations while promoting patient safety, accurate clinical documentation, and continuous quality improvement.

The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of healthcare compliance, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate multiple priorities in a fast-paced healthcare environment. We are looking for someone who takes initiative, recognizes potential compliance concerns, and works collaboratively with clinical leadership to implement effective solutions.

If you are passionate about healthcare quality, regulatory compliance, and improving organizational processes, we encourage you to apply!

Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

  • Monitor organizational compliance with applicable federal, state, and local healthcare regulations, including AHCA, CMS, CHAP, APD, and Qlarant requirements.

  • Track regulatory updates, provider advisories, and changes affecting healthcare operations.

  • Assist with reviewing, developing, and updating organizational policies and procedures.

  • Coordinate regulatory inspection preparation, accreditation surveys, and compliance reviews.

  • Identify potential compliance deficiencies, recommend corrective actions, and monitor resolution.

Clinical Auditing & Documentation Review

  • Conduct routine audits of patient clinical records to verify documentation accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.

  • Review medication administration records (MARs), medication documentation, and related clinical records for accuracy and compliance.

  • Audit employee and clinical personnel files to verify required credentials, training, background screenings, and regulatory documentation.

  • Identify documentation deficiencies and coordinate follow-up with the appropriate clinical or administrative personnel.

  • Maintain audit logs, compliance trackers, and supporting documentation.

Quality Assurance & Performance Improvement (QAPI)

  • Support the development, implementation, and ongoing monitoring of quality assurance initiatives.

  • Collect and analyze compliance data to identify trends, recurring deficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Assist with QAPI meetings, performance monitoring, and quality improvement projects.

  • Develop and maintain corrective action tracking systems to ensure timely resolution of identified concerns.

  • Monitor the effectiveness of corrective actions and report outstanding compliance issues to leadership.

Staff Compliance, Training & Education

  • Monitor staff compliance with required training, certifications, professional licenses, and continuing education requirements.

  • Coordinate with Human Resources and clinical leadership to address missing, expired, or incomplete compliance documentation.

  • Assist with new-hire orientation and provide training on clinical documentation, regulatory requirements, and organizational policies.

  • Develop and distribute compliance reminders, educational materials, and procedural updates.

  • Support clinical leadership in identifying training needs and coordinating corrective education.

Internal Audits, Investigations & Corrective Actions

  • Conduct scheduled and targeted internal compliance audits.

  • Assist with investigating reported compliance concerns, documentation discrepancies, and potential policy violations.

  • Document findings, maintain supporting records, and prepare recommendations for corrective action.

  • Follow up with responsible departments to verify timely completion of corrective measures.

  • Escalate significant compliance concerns to the Administrator or designated clinical leadership.

Clinical Operations & Team Support

  • Collaborate with the Director of Nursing, RN Case Managers, and other clinical personnel to support compliance with established standards of care.

  • Assist with tracking required patient assessments, recertifications, transfers, discharges, and resumptions of care.

  • Monitor the timely completion of clinical documentation and required supervisory visits.

  • Coordinate follow-up on outstanding clinical records, documentation deficiencies, and compliance-related action items.

  • Support clinical staff with education and guidance regarding documentation requirements and organizational procedures.

  • When appropriately licensed and authorized, assist with clinical assessments, supervisory visits, care coordination, and other nursing functions as needed.

Compliance Reporting & Administrative Coordination

  • Maintain accurate compliance records, audit reports, inspection documentation, and corrective action logs.

  • Prepare routine compliance summaries and status reports for the Administrator and clinical leadership.

  • Track regulatory deadlines, license renewals, required inspections, and other compliance-related obligations.

  • Coordinate documentation requests from regulatory agencies, accreditation organizations, and internal leadership.

  • Maintain organized electronic and physical compliance records to support audit readiness.

Patient Safety, Confidentiality & Ethical Standards

  • Promote compliance with HIPAA and organizational confidentiality policies.

  • Support safe patient care practices, infection prevention protocols, and applicable workplace safety requirements.

  • Identify and report potential patient safety concerns through established organizational procedures.

  • Maintain professionalism, ethical judgment, and discretion when handling sensitive information.

  • Support the organization's commitment to quality care, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Associate's or bachelor's degree in Nursing, Healthcare Administration, Health Information Management, or a related healthcare field preferred.

  • Minimum of 1-3 years of experience in healthcare compliance, clinical administration, quality assurance, medical records auditing, or a related healthcare function.

  • Experience in home health, residential care, assisted living, or another regulated healthcare environment strongly preferred.

  • Working knowledge of AHCA, CMS, HIPAA, and applicable healthcare compliance requirements.

  • Familiarity with clinical documentation, patient records, medication administration records, and quality assurance processes.

Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.

  • Ability to interpret regulatory requirements and apply established procedures.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

title: Assistant General Manager at Marina Bar & Grill
location: Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort, Miramar Beach, FL, US
description:
Nestled on the shimmering shores of Choctawhatchee Bay, Marina Bar & Grill is Sandestin Golf & Beach Resort’s vibrant waterfront destination where casual coastal vibes meet mouthwatering flavors. Marina Bar & Grill is a casual, open-air restaurant located on the bay, known for its laid-back charm, family-friendly atmosphere, and beautiful sunsets. The AGM will operate in both indoor and outdoor settings, assisting with all areas of operations to ensure the highest levels of guest satisfaction while maintaining a fun, energetic, and team-driven environment.

title: Fire Shop Associate
description:
Job Summary:

The Fire Shop Associate supports the daily operations of the fire protection branch by maintaining an organized, safe, and efficient shop environment. This position is responsible for receiving, organizing, stocking, and distributing equipment, parts, tools, and supplies to support field technicians and branch operations. The Fire Shop Associate works closely with Service Technicians, Project Managers, Operations Managers, Purchasing, and other Branch team members to ensure materials and equipment are available when needed and are maintained in accordance with company safety, quality, and operational standards.


Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • None

Essential Job Functions:

  • Receives, inspects, organizes, and stocks parts, equipment, products, and supplies into inventory on a daily basis.
  • Maintains accurate inventory levels and communicates with purchasing representatives regarding replenishment needs and material shortages.
  • Pulls and stages parts, equipment, tools, and materials for technicians, service requests, projects, and other Branch requirements.
  • Maintains an accurate and organized inventory system, including tracking the allocation and movement of materials to field personnel and job sites.
  • Assists with scheduled inventory counts and reconciles discrepancies as needed.
  • Maintains a clean, safe, orderly, and secure shop environment in accordance with company policies and applicable safety requirements.
  • Ensures walkways, work areas, storage areas, and access points remain clear and free of hazards.
  • Properly stores equipment, parts, tools, and materials to prevent damage, loss, or unsafe conditions.
  • Assists with loading and unloading deliveries and prepares materials for transportation to customers and job sites.
  • May operate a forklift, pallet jack, or other material-handling equipment in accordance with company safety procedures and training requirements.
  • May deliver or transport materials, equipment, and supplies to customers, job sites, or other company locations as needed.
  • Reports damaged, missing, defective, or unsafe equipment and materials to local management.
  • Assists in maintaining shop tools, equipment, and vehicles in a clean and serviceable condition.
  • Follows all company safety policies, procedures, and quality standards.
  • Performs other related duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Experience & Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma, GED or equivalent required.
  • Previous experience in a shop, warehouse, fire protection, construction, maintenance, or related environment preferred.
  • Basic mechanical aptitude and familiarity with hand tools, power tools, and general shop equipment preferred.
  • Forklift and/or pallet jack experience preferred; ability to complete required training and certification as applicable.
  • Ability to read work orders, pick lists, and other job-related documentation and follow written and verbal instructions.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate inventory records.
  • Basic computer skills with the ability and willingness to learn inventory and company-specific software.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook preferred.
  • Ability to communicate effectively and work cooperatively with technicians, management, customers, vendors, and other team members.
  • Maintain a valid driver's license and acceptable driving record.

Physical Requirements:

  • Regularly utilizes a computer, telephone, and other office/shop equipment and may participate in virtual and in-person meetings.
  • Requires frequent standing, walking, bending, reaching, stooping, climbing, and working on your feet for extended periods, including up to eight hours per day.

title: Training & Development Specialist
description:
Training & Development Specialist

Location: Maryland Heights, MO
Job Type: Full-time, on-site
Compensation: Starting at $85,000 annually plus 10% annual incentive opportunity. Actual starting pay will be based on experience, skills, and overall qualifications.

About ECS

We’re in the risk management business. With our help, our clients keep their fire sprinkler systems safe. Whether it’s a risk to lives, structures, properties, or everyday business, we guide clients to the best answer for their safety. Corrosion is our enemy and safety is our goal.

To accomplish that goal, we’ve come to understand why and how corrosion happens. There’s no one-size-fits-all solution because a truly cost-effective combination of devices, systems, and management approaches depends on your individual needs. And we never stop finding new and better ways to serve those needs.

About the Role

The Training & Development Specialist role primarily consists of assessing training requirements, designing curriculum, delivering training sessions using various methodologies, and managing day-to-day learning activities for new and existing employees. This role helps build and deliver a scalable, internal training program that supports employee development and the company’s growth.

The role will work to identify ECS’s training needs by collaborating with teams and subject matter experts (SMEs) across the company. These needs will be fulfilled by developing and delivering eLearning, instructor-led training (ILT), and virtual instructor-led training (VILT). The type of training to be delivered will primarily be Technical and Process (“How-To”) style training. However, there will likely be aspects of Onboarding, Product Compliance and Non-Product Compliance training as well.

The role also coordinates training schedules, maintains curriculum resources, and contributes to the overall training strategy.

The successful candidate will bring experience in instructional design and group facilitation, along with familiarity with learning management systems (LMS), KPI development and reporting, and Salesforce. The candidate will also develop knowledge of fire sprinkler systems, fire protection concepts, company products and services, and general sales processes.

What You'll Do

  • Design, coordinate, and facilitate engaging instructor-led and virtual training programs that support employee development across the organization.
  • Partner with subject matter experts and department leaders to develop training content, deliver impactful learning experiences, and ensure training aligns with business needs.
  • Administer role-based onboarding programs, helping new employees build the knowledge and skills needed for success.
  • Maintain employee training records, certifications, and learning documentation to support compliance and workforce development initiatives.
  • Ensure training materials, curriculum, and delivery methods remain current with industry trends, regulations, and emerging technologies.
  • Support ECS's training strategy by collaborating with departmental stakeholders to identify learning needs and drive continuous improvement in training programs.
  • Coordinate training logistics, including scheduling sessions, preparing training environments, managing equipment, and supporting studio-based learning activities.
  • Record and maintain training videos and virtual learning resources to expand access to training and reinforce key concepts.
  • Assist with the maintenance of training equipment, A/V technology, and departmental processes to ensure a seamless learning experience.
  • Partner closely with Human Resources and cross-functional teams to promote employee development initiatives and foster a culture of continuous learning.
  • Train, mentor, and support future members of the Training team, helping build organizational learning capabilities for the future.

title: Director, Product Design
description:
About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

About Docker

Docker gives developers the tools to build, ship, and run software. Millions of developers use Docker every day, and we are now building the platform layer for AI agents on top of the container workflow they already know.

We are a small design team that works close to engineering and holds a high bar for craft.

About the role

We're looking for a Director of Product Design to lead the team behind existing and new products in the Docker portfolio, spanning our GUIs and the CLI. You'll manage the designers and raise the quality of what they ship, and you'll stay close enough to the work to build and critique it yourself, from the first prototype to the details of spacing, states, and copy.

You'll work alongside our principal designers, our Director of UX Research, design engineers, engineering leaders, and product leaders to turn technically complex systems into experiences that feel clear to the person using them.

You will report to the SVP of Design. This role is remote, with working hours that overlap US and Europe time zones.

What you will do

  • Lead and grow the product design team.

  • Set the craft bar expected at each level and hold it through critique and your own work.

  • Partner with engineering and product from the start of a project, so design and engineering ship together.

  • Give designers ownership of important problems, with the context and trust to make good calls.

  • Shape how the team works with AI tools: human judgment leads, and the tools speed up the work.

  • Work with design engineering and the design system team so the shared system helps teams move faster without limiting new ideas.

About you

You lead people:

  • You have led a product design team of comparable size through change, and you have grown designers from mid-level through senior and staff.

  • You have partnered closely with design engineers and engineering leaders, and you can engage with the technical decisions that shape the experience.

  • You state a clear point of view to engineering and product leaders and stay open to challenge and better ideas.

You build:

  • You still make things. You can prototype, critique a flow at the level of spacing, states, motion, and copy, and show us work from the last year. We will ask to see it.

  • You use AI tools in your daily work and can show how you use them, including when you step in because the output isn't good enough.

  • You have designed technically complex products and can turn underlying systems into experiences that feel clear and intuitive.

Bonus if you

  • Have led design for AI-powered or agent products, including experiences beyond a graphical interface.

  • Have designed for both developer-led adoption and complex enterprise customers.

  • Can prototype in front-end code, such as React or TypeScript.

Docker does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Compensation & Equity

United States: $206,500 – $295,000 + equity

______________________________________________________________________

Posting Information

  • Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.

  • AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.

  • Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

______________________________________________________________________

Perks & Benefits

  • Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.

  • Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.

  • Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.

  • Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.

  • Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.

  • Learning & development – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning.

  • Parental leave – 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment.

  • Equity for all full-time employees – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow.

  • Comprehensive benefits – Medical, retirement, and paid holidays vary by country.

  • Docker swag – Because representing the whale never gets old.

Docker is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diverse teams build better products, make better decisions, and better serve our global community.

title: ISSM Security Manager
description:
Overview

Security Manager - ISSM

LOCATION: Eglin AFB, FL

JOB STATUS: Full-time

CLEARANCE: Secret; TS/SCI

CERTIFICATION: DoD 8140 Advanced Proficiency Certification

TRAVEL: 10%

Astrion has an exciting opportunity for an Information System Security Manager (ISSM) supporting the 96 Test Wing under the Air Force Division located at the Eglin AFB, FL.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS / SKILLS

  • Must have an active DoD Secret security clearance.
  • The ideal candidate will have 10+ years’ experience as an ISSM/ISSE/ISSO/System Administrator/Network Administrator.
  • Master’s Degree in applicable discipline; additional experience may be substituted for the degree.
  • DoD 8140 Advanced Proficiency Certification for ISSM or related position.
  • Experience with the system security engineering lifecycle for Department of War (DoW)/Department of The Air Force (DAF) programs: They'd understand how security is integrated into the acquisition process, from requirements definition to verification testing and deployment.
  • Experience with DoW/DAF Cybersecurity requirements and Risk Management Framework authorization processes.
  • Experience managing and executing cybersecurity incident response processes and reporting requirements.
  • Experience with the Enterprise Mission Assurance Support Service (eMASS), Assured Compliance Assessment Solution (ACAS), and endpoint security tools (e.g., ESS/MS Defender Suite for Endpoint/Server).
  • Experience managing, executing, and reporting on cybersecurity continuous monitoring requirements to include implementing and monitoring Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) requirements.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS / SKILLS

  • Active Top Secret DoD security clearance

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • The candidate shall provide advice and assistance services in support of the implementation of cybersecurity safeguards while developing, coordinating, and implementing short- and long-term strategies during all phases of the system development lifecycle.
  • Develop, assess, write, manage, and maintain Interim Authority to Test (IATT), Authority to Operate (ATO), and Security Impact Analysis (SIA).
  • Oversee implementation of Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) requirements, while interpreting and integrating all applicable policies, instructions, and procedures according to appropriate Security Classification Guides (SCGs).
  • Maintain DoD 8140 Advanced Proficiency Certification for ISSM or related position (e.g., Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)).
  • Ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of classified ISs and data using DoW/DAF approved security engineering standards, industry best practices, and by employing new technologies.
  • Advise and assist the Government in performing initial and recurring Authorization of systems or networks at the appropriate protection level as directed by the appropriate cognizant authority.
  • Security Planning and Documentation: The ISSM develops and maintains essential security documentation, including:
  • System Security Plan (SSP): A comprehensive document that describes the security controls implemented on the system.
  • Security Assessment Report (SAR): Documents the results of security assessments and identifies any vulnerabilities.
  • Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M): Tracks the progress of remediating vulnerabilities and implementing security controls.
  • Assessment and Authorization (A&A): The ISSM plays a vital role in the A&A process, which is the process of obtaining authorization to operate (ATO) a system. This involves:
  • Preparing the system for security assessments.
  • Working with security assessors to identify vulnerabilities.
  • Developing and implementing corrective action plans.
  • Presenting the system to the Authorizing Official (AO) for approval.
  • Configuration Management: The ISSM ensures that the information system is configured securely and that all changes are properly authorized and documented.
  • Access Control: The ISSM manages access control to the information system, ensuring that only authorized users have access to sensitive data.
  • Vulnerability Management: The ISSM identifies, assesses, and mitigates vulnerabilities in the information system. This involves:
  • Conducting vulnerability scans.
  • Applying security patches.
  • Implementing other security measures to protect against known vulnerabilities.
  • Collaboration and Communication: The ISSM works closely with other cybersecurity professionals, system administrators, program managers, and other stakeholders to ensure that the information system is secure.
  • They need to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Revenue Platform
description:
Veo is a global leader in AI-based sports camera technology. Our innovative, fully automatic camera solution enables sports teams to record matches and training sessions without a camera operator. We’re democratizing the world of sports by granting video analysis for teams on all levels—a privilege that used to be only for the few. More than 40,000 clubs in 90+ countries record their games every week.
But what truly sets us apart? Our people. We’re a diverse group of innovative thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who believe in delivering an incredible product—and having fun while doing it.


The Opportunity

Veo's Revenue Platform is the engine that drives the business. Each subscription, order, invoice, payment and shipment passes through the platform that our team built. We are looking for a senior engineer to help take it to the next level.

The team owns the core revenue engine that sits between Veo's products and the systems that run the business: billing, payments, CRM, ERP and fulfillment. Other teams use our APIs to sell, quote, bill and provision. Finance relies on us to get the numbers right.

The foundations are in place. The next chapter is about making the platform more robust, easier to build on, and ready for new markets, products and pricing models. You'll model subscription lifecycles, amendments, quotes, tax and payment flows. You'll make workflows stay correct when a third-party API fails halfway through an order. You'll also work closely with Finance, Sales and Product so the business logic in code matches how the business actually works.

What You Will Do

  • Evolve and scale backend services in Rust that process real revenue: orders, subscriptions, invoicing, payments and provisioning.
  • Strengthen our Temporal workflows so they are reliable, idempotent and safe to change, through versioning and replay.
  • Shape the Revenue Platform API into a clear, OpenAPI-first product that internal teams can adopt with confidence.
  • Improve our integrations with billing, payment, CRM, ERP and logistics providers, and handle their failure modes properly.
  • Turn ambiguous commercial requirements (pricing changes, new markets, new payment methods) into correct, well-documented business logic.
  • Own what you ship in production: observability, alerting, incident response, and data migrations that touch thousands of customer accounts.
  • Incorporate modern AI development tools into your workflow to iterate quickly and build thoughtful software solutions.
  • Set technical direction for the platform's next phase, and raise the bar through design reviews, code reviews and testing.

What You Could Bring

  • 5+ years as a software engineer, with significant backend experience.
  • Backend experience using Python, Rust, or another comparable language. Rust in production is ideal, but we'll also consider strong backend engineers who have built real things in Rust and want to go deeper.
  • Experience in revenue-critical domains is a plus: billing, subscriptions, payments, e-commerce, or financial systems.
  • Strong API design skills, and experience integrating with third-party APIs that don't always behave.
  • Experience building distributed systems where correctness under failure matters.
  • The judgement to make architectural calls and to improve a live system without stopping the business.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams. You've worked closely with product managers, designers, finance, data and commercial stakeholders, and you're comfortable bringing them along on technical trade-offs.
  • A product-oriented mindset. You care about the outcome, not just the code. You ask why before how, and you treat the platform's API and its internal users with the same care as an external product.
  • Curiosity about modern AI development tools and how they can support everyday engineering workflows.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken.

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to contribute meaningfully.

title: Senior Solidity Smart Contract Developer
description:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience

Tech Stack

Solidity, Foundry, Hardhat, TypeScript, OpenZeppelin, Slither, GitHub Actions, Tenderly, Etherscan APIs

Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and links to deployed contracts or audit reports you've contributed to. Shortlisted candidates will complete a take-home contract exercise followed by a technical interview.

title: Director of Engineering, Data Platform
description:
The team + the role

Pendo's Data Platform is the backbone of everything we do. Our systems process more than 50 billion events per day, peaking at over 1 million events per second, and manage dozens of petabytes of data across several production environments. The platform powers real-time data ingestion, batch processing, and analytics at scale — and the instrumentation standards that keep our entire codebase observable. It's built primarily in Go, runs on Google Kubernetes Engine, and relies on Cloud Pub/Sub, Firestore, Google Cloud Storage, Redis, and memcache. We expect the stack to evolve, and you'll help decide how.

We're looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the teams that own this infrastructure. This is a leadership role with real technical depth — you'll set strategy, build and grow high-performing engineering teams, and partner closely with Site Reliability Engineering. You'll stay close enough to the code to review designs, debug production issues, and contribute when it matters. You'll also own the economics of running the platform at this scale and be a trusted voice with customers on performance, data integrity, and reliability. If you want a role where architectural decisions have immediate business consequence and the technical bar is genuinely high, this is it.

This role is based in Raleigh, NC and follows Pendo's hybrid model: in-office 3 days per week.

What this looks like day-to-day
  • Lead multiple engineering teams responsible for our real-time data ingestion pipeline, analytics batch job pipelines, and analytics query engine — setting technical direction and roadmap while balancing near-term delivery with long-term scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.
  • Drive architectural decisions across storage, compute, and data modeling; know when to adopt, build, or retire technologies and make those calls with conviction and clear rationale.
  • Own instrumentation standards across the core codebase — structured logging, OpenTelemetry metrics and tracing — ensuring teams across the organization can adopt them with minimal friction and that the resulting telemetry is useful, consistent, and cost-conscious.
  • Own the cost profile of the data platform at petabyte scale: forecast infrastructure spend for new product initiatives, improve cost attribution by customer, product, feature, and team, and diagnose and resolve cost overruns quickly.
  • Partner with SRE on shared on-call responsibilities, incident response, postmortems, and reliability roadmaps; define and track SLOs for ingestion latency, query performance, and data correctness.
  • Serve as a technical authority in customer conversations on platform performance, data integrity, and reliability — translating customer needs and escalations into clear engineering priorities.
  • Hire, coach, and develop engineering managers and senior engineers; build a team culture grounded in high standards, clear communication, and continuous improvement.
Who you are

Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.

You're a builder, not a maintainer.

You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great engineering directors don't just manage delivery — they operate as technical owners, setting architectural direction, making cost and reliability tradeoffs visible before they become crises, and building teams that can operate at the same level of ambition.

You're AI-curious — genuinely.

You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them — and you bring that same orientation to your teams. You evaluate emerging tools with sound judgment, separate meaningful shifts from hype, and guide the adoption of AI-assisted and agentic coding practices across the organization in a way that raises the bar rather than creates new risk.

Must-haves
  • Several years of engineering management experience, including managing managers or multiple teams; a track record of building high-performing teams in a high-growth SaaS environment.
  • Demonstrated experience building and operating large-scale, data-intensive distributed systems in production — ideally at a scale comparable to 50B+ events per day and petabyte-level data management.
  • Strong experience across real-time data ingestion, batch processing, and analytics or query systems.
  • Demonstrated cost and financial acumen at infrastructure scale: forecasting, optimization, attribution, and overrun diagnosis; ability to build a credible cost model and communicate its assumptions to both technical and financial stakeholders.
  • Deep experience with diverse database technologies — relational (SQL), document (NoSQL), columnar, and vector; hands-on experience with Firestore or similar is a strong plus.
  • Hands-on experience with multiple cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, Azure), including object storage and managed data services; deep GCP experience is especially valuable.
  • Experience with message queuing and streaming systems (Pub/Sub, Kafka, SQS, or similar), caching technologies (Redis, Valkey, memcache), and containerized workloads on Kubernetes at scale.
  • Working knowledge of observability practices and tooling, ideally including OpenTelemetry; comfort reading, reviewing, and contributing to Go code.
  • Ability to communicate credibly with customers, executives, and engineers on complex topics — performance tradeoffs, consistency guarantees, reliability commitments — and the sound judgment to make pragmatic, well-reasoned decisions in ambiguous situations.
Nice-to-haves
  • Experience with high-cardinality, high-volume event or telemetry data.
  • Background in multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
  • Familiarity with FinOps practices and cloud billing data, including cost allocation approaches such as tagging, labeling, and usage-based attribution.
  • Contributions to open-source projects in the data or observability ecosystem.
About Pendo

Pendo was founded in 2013 by former product managers, who combined their heads and hearts to build something they wanted but never had as product managers: a simple way to understand and attack what truly drives product success. Our mission is to improve society's experience with software. Come join one of the fastest-growing startups, supported by best-in-class institutions like Battery Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, Spark Capital and Meritech.

Pendo core values: Bias to Act, Hone Your Craft, The Team is Pendo, and Maniacal Focus.

Location: Pendo is a hybrid culture. In our Raleigh office 3 days per week.

Benefits: Highly competitive, employer-heavy coverage (including $0 premium options), strong 401(k) match, equity, and flexible time off.

Compensation: Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide.

The expected salary range for this role to be performed in North Carolina is USD $235,000 – USD $280,000.

EEOC: We are an equal opportunity employer and believe having diverse teams where everyone brings their whole self to Pendo is key to our success. We welcome all people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

Accessibility: Pendo is committed to working with, and providing access and reasonable accommodation to, applicants with mental and/or physical disabilities. If you think you may require an accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, please send a request to: accommodation@pendo.io. All requests for accommodations are treated discreetly and confidentially, as practical and permitted by law.

title: GTM Data Analyst
description:
Netic is the AI revenue engine for essential services who are the backbone of the American economy. With $43M in funding from Founders Fund, Greylock, Hanabi, and Dylan Field who led our Series B, we helped our customers book hundreds of thousands of jobs across services industries in North America. You’ll join our team with relentless builders from Scale, Databricks, HRT, Meta, MIT, Stanford, and Harvard in bringing frontier AI to the physical economy, where the problems are hard, the data is complex, and the impact is immediate and tangible.

The role

You'll be Netic's first dedicated go-to-market data hire. Nobody owns our account and contact data end to end yet: you will. You'll define the data standards, build the models and checks that keep them accurate, and give the team a foundation for territories, routing, forecasting and commissions.

This is an analyst role with operational ownership. You'll spend as much time writing SQL and building models as you do fixing the processes that create bad data in the first place.

What you'll do

  • Own the GTM data model: define account, contact and hierarchy standards (parent companies, multi-location operators, PE-backed roll-ups), required fields at each stage, and the rules for creating, matching and merging records.

  • Build our total addressable market model: map every home services business by trade, geography and location count, score it, and keep it in sync with Salesforce.

  • Design and run enrichment workflows that keep firmographics and decision-maker contacts current, and measure the coverage and accuracy of each data source.

  • Define data quality metrics (duplicate rate, field completeness, match rate) and build the dashboards and alerts that catch bad data before it reaches a forecast or a commission statement.

  • Maintain the data behind territory assignments and lead routing, and give Sales Ops the evidence to resolve ownership disputes.

  • Run analyses that answer GTM questions: which segments convert, where coverage is thin, and which accounts we're missing.

  • Automate recurring cleanup and validation with our Sales Systems engineer, so hygiene runs as a system instead of a project.

What success looks like in year one

  • A documented standard for accounts, contacts and hierarchies that every team follows.

  • A TAM model the sales team uses to plan territories and prioritize accounts.

  • Data quality metrics tracked weekly, with duplicate rates and field gaps trending down.

  • Recurring cleanup automated rather than done by hand.

What you bring

  • 2+ years in sales operations, revenue operations, marketing operations or data analytics at a B2B company.

  • Strong SQL and advanced Excel or Google Sheets; Python is a plus. You're comfortable building a model or analysis from raw, messy data.

  • Hands-on Salesforce data experience (Data Loader, Workbench or a dedupe tool) and a solid grasp of the object model.

  • A detail-first mindset. You notice when a number looks off and you chase it to the root cause.

  • The ownership to define standards, not only follow them, and the documentation habits to make them outlast you.

Nice to have

  • Experience with ZoomInfo, Clay, Apollo, LeanData, Cloudingo or DemandTools.

  • Familiarity with BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Hex) or a data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery).

  • Experience using AI coding assistants to automate data work.

Our values

  1. Obsess over the customer

  2. Every second counts

  3. Sweat the details

  4. There are no blockers

  5. Be self-directed

  6. Seek and speak the truth

  7. Enjoy the ride

title: Engineering Manager, Machine Learning
description:
Role & Team

As an ML Engineering Manager, you will lead across several cross-functional teams, managing up to ~10 machine learning engineers and data scientists. You will support teams working on data- and machine-learning-driven product capabilities.

Our product teams are cross functional and will typically include product managers, designers, engineers and subject matter experts relating to the team’s domain.

You will be accountable for the technical direction and delivery outcomes of your area. You will challenge your teams to pursue ambitious goals while providing a high level of support — growing engineering talent and fostering a highly collaborative, team-based environment where people can do great work.

Your primary focus will be on building high-performing teams and driving results through others. You will not be expected to spend significant time doing hands-on coding; however, you will be expected to dive deep technically when required and leverage your experience to support strong technical decision-making.

Time zone requirement: Europe (GMT/WET, CET, EET) and Eastern North America (NST, AST, EST)

What You'll Do

  • Enable our Machine Learning and data teams to operate as highly productive, cross-functional teams delivering high-quality ML-driven capabilities

  • Support teams working with satellite imagery and geospatial datasets, balancing experimentation, iteration, and ongoing improvement of existing solutions

  • Grow the teams by attracting and hiring great Data and ML talent

  • Foster an inclusive, supportive, and caring culture where everyone can do their best work

  • Provide regular 1:1 coaching and feedback to help others thrive, grow, and reach their aspirations

  • Act as a strategic partner to Product Managers within your domains, ensuring technical decisions balance short- and long-term goals

  • Ensure the technical approaches within your domains support future product and modelling needs

  • Work closely with other Product, Design and Engineering leaders on strategy, technology, and people

  • Help evolve Data and ML practices and introduce ways of working that improve collaboration, delivery, and learning

Skills & Experience

  • 8+ years of professional experience building ML- or data-driven systems, at least 3 years’ experience leading and managing ML or data-focused teams

  • Passionate about climate and the role technology can play in addressing environmental challenges

  • Experience working in a high-growth scale-up or startup environment

  • Product-minded, with the ability to demonstrate meaningful business impact through technology

  • Sufficient technical depth in machine learning, data systems, or applied ML to guide teams and challenge decisions

  • Experience working with python-based ML or data workflows and collaborating closely with data scientists

  • Strong leadership skills, with a coaching mindset and the ability to support engineers and data scientists at all levels

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional environments

  • Passion for learning and staying current with evolving technologies and industry trend

Nice To Have

  • Engineering mindset or background, with experience applying software engineering best practices to data and ML systems (e.g., reproducibility, testing, monitoring, and production deployments)

Note: We believe that all people are capable of great things. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all of the requirements that are listed within this job description.

What We Offer

  • Competitive, location-specific compensation and benefits

  • Flexible, autonomous and collaborative working environment rooted in trust - we build our work days around our lives, not the other way around

  • Home office stipend, coworking and ongoing education budgets

  • A company culture that genuinely embodies each of our core values

  • To be part of truly mission-driven work that reduces wildfires, protects earth’s natural resources and helps solve our climate crisis

UJET leads the way in AI-powered contact center innovation, delivering a future-proof, cloud platform that redefines the customer experience with cutting-edge AI, true multimodality, and a mobile-first approach.
