Opportunity

UJET is searching for a Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack) to join our growing team! The ideal candidate is an experienced fullstack engineer who owns epics and features of significant complexity end-to-end across the frontend and backend, and who is meticulous with code style and quality. As a Senior engineer, you will define and execute against timelines, resources, and other constraints, break epics down into tickets, and mentor our L1 and L2 engineers. You are a strong practitioner of AI-driven development — using AI coding tools and agents to accelerate your own delivery while upholding our quality bar.

Responsibilities
  • Own epics and deliver features, services, and refactors of significant complexity across product software engineering — from ticket breakdown through deployment and post-release validation
  • Define and execute against timelines, resources, and other constraints, flagging risks and trade-offs early
  • Break down epics into well-scoped tickets and sequence the work with your team
  • Become the SME for one or more areas of your team's domain and a dependable go-to person within the team
  • Design and build fullstack features and services with high availability, low latency, and auto scalability
  • Author and review technical design documents (TDDs); design service boundaries, data models, and APIs balancing simplicity, performance, and extensibility
  • Partner with PM, Design, QA, PMO, and SRE through the full software development lifecycle, participating in planning, estimation, and prioritization

  • Build and maintain unit, integration, and contract tests; instrument logging, metrics, and tracing so systems are observable in production
  • Participate in the on-call rotation; triage, mitigate, and document production incidents and drive follow-up actions from postmortems
  • Identify and pay down technical debt, modernizing legacy code to protect long-term maintainability
  • Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows to accelerate delivery, applying our team guardrails and quality standards to anything they produce
  • Mentor L1 and L2 engineers, contribute to onboarding docs, and share knowledge through brown-bags, internal talks, and architecture reviews

  • 5+ years' experience in software development, with solid fullstack (frontend and backend) development experience and a track record of owning epics or features of significant complexity
  • You have strong foundational knowledge of modern, distributed computing.
  • You understand the performance characteristics of the services you own and can reason about them quantitatively.
  • Working experience around a breadth of datastores including MySQL, NoSQL, Redis or Elasticsearch
  • Efficiency in software best practice and tools like Git, Docker, CI, 12factor, etc
  • Experience working within a microservice architecture
  • Capable of writing optimal code across the stack, including at least one backend language (Java, Go, Ruby, Python) and a modern frontend framework (e.g., React, Angular)
  • Hands-on proficiency with AI-driven development — AI coding assistants and agentic workflows (e.g., Claude, Copilot, Cursor) — with the judgment to apply them effectively while upholding code quality
  • Experience mentoring less experienced engineers and collaborating cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience

title: QUALIFIED BEHAVIOR MANAGEMENT PROFESSIONAL
description:
Qualified Behavior Management Professional

Kala Houses | Elverta, CA

$95,000 to $102,000

Join a team that changes lives every day.

At Advance Kids, we believe every individual deserves the opportunity to live a meaningful, fulfilling life. For more than 25 years, we have provided innovative residential, clinical, educational, and crisis intervention services for children, teens, and adults with autism spectrum disorder and developmental disabilities. Our mission is simple: to improve quality of life through compassionate, individualized support and evidence-based care.

We are seeking a dedicated QBMP to support our Kala Houses, Residential Crisis programs.The current vacancy is for our IMD step down home (individuals coming from an Institution of mental disease with co-morbid developmental disabilities). QBMP works closely with our mental health providers as well as our medical team. This is an opportunity to work alongside a multidisciplinary team that values integrity, accountability, collaboration, and clinical excellence while making a profound impact on the lives of individuals with complex support needs.

Position Summary

The QBMP develops, implements, monitors, and revises Individual Behavior Support Plans (IBSPs) and Individual Emergency Intervention Plans (IEIPs) for residents residing in Kala residential homes. The QBMP ensures services promote resident safety, independence, dignity, and quality of life while meeting regulatory standards set forth by Alta Regional Center, the Department of Developmental Services (DDS), Community Care Licensing (CCL), the Home and Community-Based Services (HCBS) Final Rule, and California Title 17.

The QBMP provides clinical oversight, staff training, supervision of Registered Behavior Technicians (RBTs), fidelity monitoring, interdisciplinary collaboration, and crisis support within residential settings.

Qualifications

Required

  • BCBA certification for minimum of 2 years.
  • Master’s Degree in Psychology, Applied Behavior Analysis, Education, or related field
  • Bachelor’s Degree with qualifying experience meeting QBMP standards under Title 17. Experience in residential services, crisis intervention, and adult populations preferred.

Physical Requirements

  • Stand, sit, kneel, bend, and move throughout residential environments
  • Respond safely during behavioral escalations
  • Travel between Kala residential locations
  • Use a computer for documentation and reporting

Pre-Employment Requirements

  • Valid and current auto insurance
  • Valid CA Driver's License
  • Pass a DMV check

Interpersonal

  • Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities; exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; gives and welcomes feedback; contributes to building a positive team spirit; puts success of team above own interests; able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; supports everyone's efforts to succeed.

Leadership

Organization

title: Mail Sorter
description:
LOCATION

Windsor, CT

WORK SCHEDULE

12 hour day or night shift

SUMMARY

Under direct supervision assume responsibility for consistently following all of Commingle Safety, Quality and Production Procedures.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES - Sweeping

  1. Achieve production standards with expected quality on a daily basis.
  2. Verify that mail is sorting to the correct bin.
  3. Ensure that the mail is placed in the correct tray.
  4. Ensure that all mail placed in the trays is facing forward and upright in the tray.
  5. Ensure bins are cleared of mail in a timely manner.
  6. Ensure that jams are cleared in a timely manner.
  7. Ensure that all trays have a tray tag prior to placing on the conveyor.
  8. Replace damaged tray tag pockets ensuring placement in the correct location.
  9. Ensure that trays are at least ¾ full before placing on conveyor.
  10. Transfer mail and tray tags from trays that are less than ¾ full to the ½ size trays.
  11. Print only the necessary amount of tray tags (print as needed) and turn in all unused tray tags at the end of each run.
  12. Ensure that machine has been cleared at the end of each run prior to dropping the trays on the conveyor.
  13. Ensure that all trays have been cleared prior to the start of the next run.
  14. Replenish trays and other supplies as necessary to keep machines running without interruption.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES – Pre-commingle

  1. Ensure job belongs in commingle mailing.
  2. Fill out required paperwork.
  3. Place trays on conveyor facing forward.
  4. Verify that mail within the tray matches the CMG # on the tray tag.
  5. Place tray on the correct pallet making sure tray tag is facing out.
  6. Ensure that jams on the conveyor are cleared in a timely manner.
  7. Ensure that trays are stacked evenly and neatly on the pallet.
  8. Verify that full pallets have the correct CMG#, fill out the required paperwork.
  9. Move pallet to the staging area.
  10. Ensure pallets are staged correctly.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES – General

  1. Properly dispose of damaged mail and materials at the end of shift.
  2. Maintain work area clean and organized at all times
  3. Communicate all issues to team lead, supervisor or manager.
  4. Comply with company rules, regulations and procedures.
  5. Maintain confidentiality of company-sensitive data.
  6. Perform other related duties as required to achieve the goals and objectives of the department and company.
  7. Assist in the training of new employees.

title: Staff Product Engineer (Frontend)
location: CAN; IND; AUS; IRL; GBR; Singapore, Singapore, SGP
description:
At Moxie, we empower ambitious aesthetic entrepreneurs to build profitable, independent practices—without burnout, overwhelm, or guesswork. In just a few years, we've grown from an idea to a global, remote-first team now supporting 700+ practices nationwide.

Our purpose is simple: to unlock sustainable success for aesthetic entrepreneurs, at every stage of their journey.

Staff Product Engineer (Frontend)

We're looking for a Staff Product Engineer to be one of Moxie's leading frontend individual contributors, driving the highest-leverage frontend initiatives across the org in Q4 2026 and Q1 2027. The center of gravity here is horizontal: how every Moxie team builds, ships, and maintains UI. You'll be a leading contributor to our Design System and the entire frontend toolchain and CI. You’ll also play a key role as we rethink and redesign our architecture, tooling, and SDLC for the agentic eraYou'll most likely sit on the Financial Operations (FinOps) team and stay hands-on in product delivery there, so your standards stay grounded in real feature work. Day to day, you'll partner with Design, Product, engineering managers of UI-heavy domains, and other staff engineers across our frontend stack (Next.js, MUI, Apollo, GraphQL, Storybook, and more). stack of Next.js, MUI, Apollo, GraphQL codegen, and Storybook.
Our Objectives for the Role

  • Ramp through real product work. Within three months you're shipping FinOps UI improvements that raise performance, consistency, or developer experience, such as consolidating a repeatedly forked pattern (such as confirm dialogs) or perhaps refactoring un-performant queries on a slow page.

  • Shape architecture across the company. Within three months you're ramped up to Moxie's system design and architecture, and opinionated on what we can do better, and what we should build next. You're comfortable developing technical proposals, and taking them from draft to review, approval, and final implementation.

  • Own non-project technical initiatives and engineering culture. Start owning at least one org-level initiative in your first three months (for example redesigning our frontend development SDLC for the agentic era), and by month nine own one or two initiatives with measurable gains in quality or velocity, while shipping v1 of one or more key initiatives.

We're Looking For

  • Design system or frontend platform experience. You've built a design system or led a large React and GraphQL migration, including design tokens, theming, component API design, and a promotion path for canonical components, and you've seen it adopted rather than decay.

  • Data layer depth. You know GraphQL client caching and fragment colocation well enough to move a complex route to one primary query with component-owned fragments, and to make that the default pattern.

  • A record of leading adoption without formal authority. You ship in slices, pilots, and migration guides instead of big-bang rewrites, and you earn adoption through clear docs and by making the right path the easy path for teams that don't report to you.

  • Hands-on product delivery. You stay in feature work, ramp quickly in a large codebase you didn't design, and can tell canonical patterns from forks.

  • Toolchain and performance sense. You've improved CI time, type-checking, or page performance with measurable results, and you can reason about where install, caching, and build time go.

  • Fluency with AI tooling in daily work. You use AI tools in how you build and have a point of view on how AI can improve the software development lifecycle. Bonus points if you’re opinionated about harnesses, tooling (Ghosty, Herdr, Pi, Plannotator, etc), and multi-agent workflows and processes.

  • Technical leadership and influence. You partner with Design, Product, and engineering managers, communicate tradeoffs and status clearly, and level up other engineers through reviews and pairing.

This is not a role for someone who wants to work only on horizontal initiatives and step away from shipping product UI.

Why Join Us?

  • Own frontend architecture for a real, multi-domain product, while also helping shape and guide Moxie’s architecture and system design..

  • High-leverage horizontal work (design system, data architecture, tooling) while staying hands-on in product delivery.

  • Build the core that people and agents both use. You'll shape an AI-native frontend where generation in Figma and in code reuses canonical components.

  • Clear accountability at Staff level for decisions that materially affect the company, without needing Principal or org-design scope.

  • Above all, we're in this to empower small business owners to own and grow their businesses. If you succeed, Med Spas will remain the opportunity for independent owner-operators instead of being dominated by a small number of large chains. If that speaks to you, speak to us.

  • Competitive salary and a fully remote setup.

At Moxie, we believe in creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, trusted, and included. Our team lives by our values: act as owners, give more than we take, move with speed and care, and simplify and learn every day.

We welcome people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to apply. If you require any accommodations to fully participate in the interview process, please let us know, we’re happy to assist.

title: Data Visualization Software Engineer
description:
Company Description

Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.

Job Description

We have an opening for a Software Engineer to help develop innovative software for ASD Scorpius, one-of-a-kind next-generation linear induction accelerator that will generate multiple, precisely timed, high-energy X-ray images during subcritical experiments, providing scientists with unprecedented experimental data to better understand material behavior under extreme conditions. You will work at the intersection of software, data, controls, and experimental science, developing intuitive data-visualization and user-interface capabilities that help scientists and engineers' access, understand, and interact with complex accelerator and experimental data. You will help build software that connects data-recall systems, databases, and accelerator controls, transforming large volumes of technical information into useful, accessible tools for the multi-disciplinary team commissioning and operating this unique system. You will work alongside experienced software developers, controls engineers, scientists, and project personnel and have the opportunity to see your software become part of a major experimental capability from development through integration and commissioning.

This is an opportunity to begin your career working on challenging, mission-critical software where the connection between code and real-world engineering is immediate. The software approaches and experience developed on Scorpius will also be applicable to other major experimental systems and future national-security capabilities at LLNL. This position is in the National Security Engineering Division (NSED) within the Engineering Directorate.

This position requires full-time on-site presence due to the nature of the work.

You will

  • Develop and maintain software applications and graphical user interfaces for visualization, retrieval, and presentation of engineering and experimental data.
  • Implement well-defined software features that interface with data sources, databases, application programming interfaces (APIs), and controls-related software.
  • Apply fundamental software engineering concepts, techniques, practices, and procedures to solve problems using standard development methodologies.
  • Develop software components using appropriate programming languages, frameworks, and development tools in accordance with established project requirements and coding practices.
  • Implement data-processing and data-recall functionality to support efficient access to engineering and experimental information.
  • Develop and execute unit, integration, and automated tests to verify software functionality, identify defects, and support reliable software operation.
  • Participate in software design discussions, code reviews, configuration management, documentation, and other established software-development lifecycle activities.
  • Collaborate with engineers, scientists, software developers, and project personnel to understand requirements, communicate technical progress, and integrate software components into larger engineering systems.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Ability to secure and maintain a U.S. DOE Q level security clearance which requires U.S. citizenship.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related science, engineering, or technical field, or equivalent level of demonstrated knowledge.
  • Fundamental knowledge of software engineering and computer science concepts, techniques, practices, and procedures, including object-oriented programming, data structures, software design, and software development lifecycle practices.
  • Fundamental knowledge and experience applying one or more modern programming languages such as Python, Java, Kotlin, C/C++, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar languages to software-development assignments.
  • Knowledge of developing software applications that interact with databases, structured data, APIs, or other software services.
  • Knowledge of graphical user interface, web application, or data-visualization development concepts and techniques.
  • Experience using standard software-development tools and practices such as version control, testing, debugging, and collaborative software-development workflows.
  • Experience applying standard technical principles, theories, concepts, and techniques to well-defined software-development problems.
  • Sufficient verbal and written communication skills to collaborate effectively in a team environment and present and explain technical information

Qualifications We Desire

  • Experience developing graphical user interfaces or interactive web applications using technologies such as React, JavaScript/TypeScript, or comparable frameworks.
  • Experience working with SQL databases, REST APIs, data-processing pipelines, or scientific/engineering data.
  • Experience with Linux development environments, Git-based workflows, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, or related modern software-development tools.

Pay Range

$121,830 - $154,500 Annually

This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting; pay will not be below any applicable local minimum wage. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Additional Information

#LI-Onsite

Position Information

This is a Career Indefinite position, open to Lab employees and external candidates.

Why Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory?

  • Included in 2026 Best Places to Work by Glassdoor!
  • Flexible Benefits Package
  • 401(k)
  • Relocation Assistance
  • Education Reimbursement Program
  • Flexible schedules (*depending on project needs)
  • Our values - visit https://www.llnl.gov/inclusion/our-values

Security Clearance

This position requires a Department of Energy (DOE) Q-level clearance. If you are selected, we will initiate a Federal background investigation to determine if you meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information or matter. Also, all L or Q cleared employees are subject to random drug testing. Q-level clearance requires U.S. citizenship.

Pre-Employment Drug Test

External applicant(s) selected for this position must pass a post-offer, pre-employment drug test. This includes testing for use of marijuana as Federal Law applies to us as a Federal Contractor.

Wireless and Medical Devices

Per the Department of Energy (DOE), Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory must meet certain restrictions with the use and/or possession of mobile devices in Limited Areas. Depending on your job duties, you may be required to work in a Limited Area where you are not permitted to have a personal and/or laboratory mobile device in your possession. This includes, but not limited to cell phones, tablets, fitness devices, wireless headphones, and other Bluetooth/wireless enabled devices.

If you use a medical device, which pairs with a mobile device, you must still follow the rules concerning the mobile device in individual sections within Limited Areas. Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities require separate approval. Hearing aids without wireless capabilities or wireless that has been disabled are allowed in Limited Areas, Secure Space and Transit/Buffer Space within buildings.

How to identify fake job advertisements

Please be aware of recruitment scams where people or entities are misusing the name of Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) to post fake job advertisements. LLNL never extends an offer without a personal interview and will never charge a fee for joining our company. All current job openings are displayed on the Career Page under “Find Your Job” of our website. If you have encountered a job posting or have been approached with a job offer that you suspect may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend you do not respond.

To learn more about recruitment scams: https://www.llnl.gov/sites/www/files/2023-05/LLNL-Job-Fraud-Statement-Updated-4.26.23.pdf

Equal Employment Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employer that is committed to providing all with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, protected veteran status, age, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

Reasonable Accommodation

Our goal is to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates applying and interviewing at the Laboratory. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please use our online form to submit a request.

California Privacy Notice

The California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) grants privacy rights to all California residents. The law also entitles job applicants, employees, and non-employee workers to be notified of what personal information LLNL collects and for what purpose. The Employee Privacy Notice can be accessed here.

title: Staff Product Manager, Machine Learning
description:
Role & Team

You’ll lead a core part of our Vegetation Intelligence, the product area that turns remote sensing imagery and data into the vegetation insights that utilities act on every day, through world-class machine learning models. It’s one of Overstory’s most foundational products, live with customers now, and it sits at the center of how we prevent outages and stop wildfires. Every missed tree is an outage or a fire that could have been prevented.

The job is twofold. One is real ML-adjacent work: pushing our detection models further and turning their raw outputs into risk data precise enough for customers to trust and act on. You’ll need to be comfortable with complex machine learning models and geospatial data, close to the data science and engineering teams, and fluent enough in model trade-offs to make good calls with data scientists and ML engineers.

The other side is where you get to build new capabilities: taking that same data and pushing it into new products and capabilities customers don't have yet. You'll run user research, ground new product bets in the decisions customers make in the field, and turn a strong model into products that prevent real fires and real outages.

You’ll report to the Director of Product and own the strategy and roadmap for this product area end to end.

Time Zone Requirement: Europe (GMT/WET, CET, EET) and Eastern North America (NST, AST, EST, CST) Comfortable maintaining 3-4 hours of overlap European working hours for collaboration with the broader Overstory team.

What You'll Do

  • Own the roadmap for Vegetation Intelligence, spanning from the ML models that produce our risk data to the products that turn it into customer action.

  • Push our detection models further, and help fold their outputs into Overstory’s broader outage and ignition risk models.

  • Contribute towards increasing the number of actionable insights: run user research, ground priorities in the operational decisions customers actually make, and make sure what we ship drives real action in the field.

  • Shift the roadmap from scaling- and technical-led to customer-driven, without losing the technical rigor that got us here.

  • Work closely with data scientists and ML engineers to turn model capability into shipped product value, and define what “good” looks like for a model in production.

  • Explore how feedback from customers and end users, like arborists, can improve model performance over time.

  • Communicate clearly and often with the broader product and engineering team, so trade-offs, model limits, and priorities stay visible.

  • Contribute to Overstory’s broader product strategy so Vegetation Insights supports where the rest of the product is headed

Skills & Experience

  • 8+ years of product management experience, with a track record that proves both craft and shipping speed.

  • Hands-on experience building and shipping products powered by machine learning models. You understand how models get built, trained, evaluated, and improved, and you can talk model performance and trade-offs directly with data scientists and ML engineers.

  • Experience turning a scaling- or technical-led roadmap into a customer-driven one, including running user research and translating it into product priorities.

  • Experience working in a fast-paced startup, comfortable with ambiguity and making calls before everything’s fully defined.

  • A track record building B2B products that customers rely on daily, including products where the value comes from turning data or model outputs into decisions customers can act on.

  • Strong written and verbal communication. You bring clarity to technical trade-offs and bring teams along as priorities shift.

  • Experience leading product strategy and roadmapping, and building consensus across product, engineering, and data science

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience building geospatial products or working with GIS technologies.

  • Experience with complex data products, especially data pipelines and platforms, including ingesting and processing large, diverse datasets from multiple sources.

  • Experience building machine learning products for image-based applications, like computer vision or image recognition.

Note: We believe that all people are capable of great things. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all of the requirements that are listed within this job description.

What we offer

  • Competitive, location-specific compensation and benefits

  • Flexible, autonomous and collaborative working environment rooted in trust - we build our work days around our lives, not the other way around

  • Home office stipend, coworking and ongoing education budgets

  • A company culture that genuinely embodies each of our core values

  • To be part of truly mission-driven work that reduces wildfires, protects earth’s natural resources and helps solve our climate crisis

description:

We’re looking for our next Senior Software Engineer. Could It Be You?

The Senior Software Engineer leads the technical design and delivery of complex, high-performance features across Questrade's products, spanning front-end applications (React Native, ReactJS) and back-end services (NodeJS, APIs, distributed systems). This role is intentionally platform-flexible: candidates may lean toward front-end, back-end, or full-stack work, with the specific focus determined collaboratively during the interview process based on the candidate's strongest expertise and the team's current needs. The Senior Software Engineer sets engineering standards, mentors developers, partners cross-functionally to ensure scalable and resilient architectures, and owns service or application health for key domain components.



Need more details? Keep reading…

In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Lead technical design and delivery of complex features and services — front-end, back-end, or both — documenting architectural trade-offs.

  • Break down large, ambiguous problems into deliverable increments and sequence them with product partners.

  • Set and enforce engineering standards for code quality, testing, security, observability, and operational readiness across the stack.

  • Own performance and scalability across your area — profiling, identifying bottlenecks, and optimizing under production load (for example, high-frequency, real-time data streaming in trading features).

  • Mentor and coach intermediate and junior developers, delivering constructive code reviews and guiding technical growth regardless of specialization.

  • Partner with Product, UX, Enterprise Architecture, and Security to ensure scalable, resilient, and compliant designs across platforms.

  • Lead incident response for significant outages in your area of ownership, driving blameless post-incident reviews to closure with structural fixes.

  • Own health for key domain components — performance, reliability, and technical debt — on the front end, back end, or both.

  • Champion the exploration and adoption of AI tools to improve developer productivity and platform features.

  • Contribute to technical hiring by conducting technical assessments and candidate interviews, including helping calibrate a candidate's front-end/back-end fit.



So are YOU our next Senior Software Engineer ? You are if you…

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 6+ years of experience building, shipping, and operating production software at scale.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise in at least one of the following tracks, with working familiarity across the stack:

  • Front-end track: Expert-level JavaScript/TypeScript with React Native (mobile) and/or ReactJS (web); strong grasp of state management, component architecture, and cross-platform performance (memory profiling, bundle size, render optimization).

  • Back-end track: Deep expertise in Node.js/TypeScript; proven experience designing distributed systems, APIs, and data models under production load.

  • Proven experience with RESTful APIs and service-oriented or microservices architectures, from either the consuming or the building side.

  • Strong cloud-native experience (GCP preferred), including CI/CD at scale; containerization/Kubernetes exposure is a plus.

  • Demonstrated experience leading technical initiatives across multiple developers without formal authority.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical trade-offs to both engineering and cross-functional audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with real-time data streaming technologies (WebSockets, Kafka, Pub/Sub) or low-latency, high-frequency financial/trading systems.

  • For back-end-leaning candidates: front-end or mobile framework exposure (ReactJS, React Native, iOS/Android) is a strong asset.

  • Angular experience is a nice-to-have.

  • Domain experience in financial services, brokerage, trading, or regulated environments.

  • SRE practices, capacity planning, or cloud cost optimization (FinOps).

  • Experience building AI/ML-enabled features or data-intensive platforms.

  • Active technical thought leadership (open-source contributions, technical publications, conference speaking).

Compensation Information:

  • Base salary range: $100,000- $144,000

  • The final compensation package will be commensurate with the successful candidate's experience, skills, and geographic location (Canada). It includes a comprehensive benefits plan and a competitive incentive (bonus) program for Full-Time Permanent roles.

title: Director of Engineering
location: Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort, Miramar Beach, FL, US
description:
Director of Engineering

Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort | Miramar Beach, Florida

About Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort

Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort is a premier destination on Florida’s Emerald Coast, spanning approximately 2,400 acres between the Gulf of Mexico and Choctawhatchee Bay. With 72 neighborhoods, approximately 1,400 vacation rental properties, four championship golf courses, a full-service marina, tennis facilities, private club amenities, multiple dining outlets, and Hotel Effie, the resort offers a diverse and complex operating environment unlike that of a traditional hotel.

The resort also features approximately 90,000 square feet of flexible meeting and event space across multiple venues, along with recreational facilities, residential communities, hospitality operations, and extensive grounds. Maintaining these varied facilities requires a hands-on, strategic engineering leader who understands the demands of a large, multi-facility resort and can balance daily operations with long-term planning.

Position Summary

The Director of Engineering is responsible for the overall operation, maintenance, repair, and long-term reliability of the resort’s buildings, infrastructure, equipment, utilities, and physical assets. This leader oversees engineering and maintenance operations across a diverse portfolio of hospitality, recreational, residential, and commercial facilities, ensuring that all properties are safe, functional, well-maintained, and operating efficiently.

This position requires a strong leader who can manage a broad range of maintenance needs, develop and mentor a skilled team, oversee capital improvement projects, manage departmental budgets, and establish preventative maintenance programs that protect the resort’s assets and enhance the guest and owner experience.

The ideal candidate has experience leading engineering operations at a large resort, destination property, or similarly complex multi-building operation. Experience limited to a single, stand-alone hotel may not provide the breadth of experience required for this position.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Engineering and Facilities Operations

• Oversee the day-to-day engineering, maintenance, and repair operations across resort facilities, including guest accommodations, common areas, restaurants, meeting and event spaces, recreational amenities, and supporting infrastructure.

• Establish and maintain preventative maintenance programs for buildings, mechanical systems, electrical systems, plumbing, HVAC, elevators, life-safety equipment, and other critical assets.

• Ensure facilities are maintained to established standards for safety, cleanliness, functionality, appearance, and guest service.

• Coordinate maintenance priorities across multiple departments and properties while minimizing disruption to guests, owners, members, and daily operations.

• Monitor the condition of buildings, equipment, roads, sidewalks, lighting, drainage, and other physical assets, identifying issues and addressing them proactively.

• Respond to emergencies, equipment failures, severe weather, and other operational issues as needed.

• Maintain appropriate records, inspections, permits, service agreements, and maintenance documentation.

Leadership and Team Development

• Lead, develop, and hold the engineering and maintenance team accountable for performance, productivity, safety, and service standards.

• Establish departmental goals, work schedules, staffing plans, and performance expectations.

• Recruit, train, coach, and develop supervisors, technicians, and other engineering personnel.

• Build strong working relationships with resort leadership and department heads to coordinate maintenance needs and operational priorities.

• Promote a culture of accountability, teamwork, continuous improvement, and timely response to maintenance requests.

Capital Projects and Asset Management

• Develop and manage capital improvement plans, equipment replacement schedules, and long-term maintenance strategies.

• Evaluate the condition and remaining useful life of major systems and equipment, making recommendations for repairs, upgrades, and replacements.

• Oversee renovation projects, equipment installations, contractor work, and facility upgrades from planning through completion.

• Obtain and evaluate contractor proposals, monitor project budgets and schedules, and ensure work meets established specifications and safety standards.

• Coordinate projects around resort occupancy, events, seasonal demand, and other operational considerations.

• Maintain accurate asset inventories and recommend investments that protect property value and improve operational efficiency.

Budgeting and Financial Management

• Prepare and manage the engineering department’s operating and capital budgets.

• Monitor labor, repair, maintenance, utilities, equipment, supplies, and contractor expenses.

• Identify opportunities to reduce operating costs without compromising safety, quality, or the guest experience.

• Review utility consumption and implement energy and water conservation initiatives where practical.

• Evaluate vendor contracts and service agreements to ensure cost-effectiveness and appropriate service levels.

• Provide regular reporting on departmental performance, project progress, expenses, and capital needs.

Safety, Compliance, and Risk Management

• Ensure compliance with applicable building codes, fire and life-safety requirements, environmental regulations, OSHA standards, and other relevant federal, state, and local requirements.

• Maintain inspection schedules and ensure deficiencies are corrected promptly.

• Support emergency preparedness, hurricane readiness, severe-weather response, and recovery efforts.

• Work closely with Security, Risk Management, Human Resources, and resort leadership to address hazards and reduce operational risks.

• Ensure employees and contractors follow established safety procedures and use equipment appropriately.

• Maintain appropriate emergency response procedures for critical equipment and infrastructure failures.

Energy, Sustainability, and Operational Improvement

• Identify opportunities to improve the reliability, efficiency, and useful life of resort facilities and equipment.

• Implement preventive and predictive maintenance practices to reduce equipment downtime and emergency repairs.

• Monitor energy and water usage and recommend improvements to building systems and operating practices.

• Evaluate new technologies, maintenance systems, and equipment that may improve productivity and reduce long-term costs.

• Establish measurable performance standards for work-order completion, preventive maintenance, equipment reliability, and departmental responsiveness.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, Construction Management, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.

• Minimum of five to seven years of progressive engineering or facilities management experience, including leadership responsibility; additional experience may be required based on the scale and complexity of the operation.

• Demonstrated experience overseeing engineering and maintenance operations for a large resort, destination property, multi-building hospitality operation, or comparable complex facility.

• Experience managing operating budgets, capital expenditures, renovation projects, contractors, and preventative maintenance programs.

• Strong working knowledge of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, mechanical systems, building infrastructure, and life-safety systems.

• Experience leading and developing a diverse maintenance and engineering team.

• Knowledge of applicable building codes, safety standards, regulatory requirements, and emergency preparedness procedures.

• Strong organizational, communication, problem-solving, and financial management skills.

• Ability to manage competing priorities, make sound decisions under pressure, and work effectively with multiple departments.

• Proficiency with maintenance management systems, work-order platforms, budgeting tools, and Microsoft Office applications.

Preferred Experience

• Previous engineering leadership experience at a large destination resort with multiple buildings, extensive recreational amenities, and significant infrastructure requirements.

• Experience supporting golf facilities, marinas, private clubs, vacation ownership properties, condominium communities, or other mixed-use resort operations.

• Experience overseeing properties with a substantial number of guest accommodations or individually maintained residential units.

• Experience managing major capital projects, renovations, utility systems, and multi-year asset replacement plans.

• Experience in a coastal market, including hurricane preparedness, storm recovery, corrosion prevention, and the maintenance challenges associated with salt air and a humid climate.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

• Ability to walk extensive distances across resort grounds, buildings, recreational facilities, and outdoor areas.

• Ability to climb stairs and ladders and access mechanical rooms, rooftops, equipment areas, and other maintenance locations when necessary.

• Ability to work indoors and outdoors in Florida’s heat, humidity, rain, and other changing weather conditions.

• Ability to inspect facilities, equipment, and work sites that may involve uneven surfaces, confined areas, noise, dust, and varying temperatures.

• Ability to respond to urgent maintenance issues, emergencies, and severe weather events, including occasional work outside normal business hours.

• Ability to communicate effectively with employees, contractors, guests, owners, and leadership across a large resort environment.

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a related field and 12 years of experience in the respective technical/professional discipline being performed, five of which must be in the DoD, OR
  • Master’s or Doctorate Degree in a related field and ten years of experience in the respective technical/professional discipline being performed, five (5) years of which must be in the DoD.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS / SKILLS

  • Apply a full range of acquisition program management philosophy, policies, and procedures, to perform a wide range of acquisition management activities in support of the existing and future F-15 Division aircraft programs.
  • Have an understanding of current DoD and AF-specific acquisition regulations, guidelines, and processes.
  • Support the acquisition program management of full life cycle requirements, subsystems and equipment.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assist with the development of documents, such as, but not limited to, Memorandum of Agreements (MOAs), Memorandum of Understandings (MOUs), Statements of Objective (SOOs), PWSs, Statements of Work (SOWs), Requests for Proposal (RFP), Mission Needs Statements, Operational Requirements Documents (ORD), Initial Capabilities Documents (ICD), Capability Development Documents (CDD), Capability Production Documents (CPD), Milestone Documentation, Analysis of Alternatives (AoA), and Rapid Fielding Requirements Documents (RFRD).
  • Proactively organizes, tracks, and responds to administrative personnel actions for the organization, such as awards, decorations, inbounds/outbounds, hiring, and similar tasks
  • Use NIPR and SIPR Task Management Tool (TMT) and e-mail to retrieve and respond to tasks.
  • Effectively communicate and collaborate with internal and external program stakeholders to evaluate, consolidate, and refine responses and solutions; organize and support meetings as needed to gain consensus and ensure accurate and timely responses.
  • Support the review of proposals as assigned by the Government. Assist with the following coordination of documentation between functional resources, including but not limited to, financial, management, procurement, engineering, and logistics) and assist with the consolidation of their inputs into common documents, and planning for the accomplishment of various program milestones.
  • Support key acquisition events and reviews as needed, such as: System Requirements Reviews (SRR), Preliminary Design Reviews (PDR), Critical Design Reviews (CDR), Test Readiness Reviews (TRR), Technical Coordination Meetings (TCM), Functional Configuration Audits (FCA), Physical Configuration Audits (PCA), Production Readiness Reviews (PRR), milestone documentation development, and others as applicable.
  • Assist in producing or reviewing products for program office use that include business case analyses, trade-off studies, estimates for program office acquisition and logistics requirements, written requirements documents for planned acquisitions, and acquisition strategies and plans.
  • Provide milestone documentation support for documents defined in DoDI 5000.02 and as tailored by the program office and milestone decision authority. Provide a program assessment for integration of documentation to ensure consistency with program strategy and consistency across all milestone documentation. Provide inputs, draft, coordinate (with the appropriate F-15 Division programs and other Government agencies), adjudicate comments, and produce final versions of coordinated milestone documents and assessments. Develop and collect technical data and inputs for staff summary packages to support coordination and signature of all associated documents for milestone approval.
  • Support the development of contract strategies, Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) and the completion of a program risk assessment to document issues impinging on milestone execution.
  • Provide technical support, plan for, coordinate, and participate in integrated program reviews and conferences, including, but not limited to, executive, readiness, technical, budget, design, weapon system, resource, requirement working groups, supportability, and management reviews. Support program briefings and reports by gathering information, preparing charts, presenting briefings, and providing other support as needed. Support shall include the management of the action item process following each review.
  • The Contractor shall provide FMS expertise for various FMS programs within the F-15 Division that are in varied DoD acquisitions stages to include planning, execution, delivery, sustainment and program closure IAW DoD policies and guidelines, if necessary.

title: Assistant or Associate Director of Admissions - Regional
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Assistant/Associate Director is a leader in the recruitment and admission of undergraduate transfer students to Alma College, as well as managing a first-year recruitment territory in the metro Detroit area. Responsibilities for this position include actively developing partnerships, recruiting, admitting, and enrolling transfer students from both community colleges and 4-year institutions. The position will also recruit, admit and enroll students in their assigned first-year recruitment territory. Salary and title commensurate with experience, skills, and abilities. This is a hybrid position with a significant amount of time spent in the metro Detroit area.


Supervision Received/Exercised:

This position reports to the Senior Director of Admissions and has no supervisory responsibilities.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Connect with community college staff at varying levels to develop collaborative partnerships and pipelines and actively recruit students
  • Create strategic partnerships with education constituents including counselors, principals, gifted and talented coordinators, AP teachers, Alma College alumni, and parents
  • Develop and manage recruitment strategies in conjunction with overall recruitment goals; review and analyze data to determine schools, fairs, and events to attend/visit; and review and analyze data to effectively recruit students to meet enrollment goals
  • Schedule visits to high schools and community colleges.
  • Coordinate pre-visit calls and correspondence, make travel arrangements, conduct information sessions, and follow up with students, faculty, and staff contacted during visits via phone calls, letters, and email
  • Manage territories to reach admission goals for both transfer and first-year students
  • Organize recruitment events both virtually and in person to meet with prospective students and families to promote undergraduate programs
  • Assess the effectiveness of current recruitment strategies for assigned territory. Develop strategies and actions to address barriers to enrollment
  • Participate in group presentations both on and off campus
  • Maintain knowledge of current financial aid options for students; work closely with the Financial Aid staff who provide financial aid counseling to students and families
  • Collaborate internally with a variety of offices and departments to engage and enroll students
  • Manage and nurture leads through the CRM (currently Slate) to communicate with students/parents through the admissions process, including academic programs, admissions requirements, scholarships, and student life
  • Evaluate applications and support documents in making admission recommendations
  • Engage in on-campus recruitment events and training. Participate and assist with event planning in support of recruitment and yield events
  • Submit timely expense reports and tracking expenditures
  • Other duties as assigned

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution
  • Three years of experience in higher education recruitment, e-recruiting, marketing, or communication, preferably in an Admissions Office
  • Familiarity and demonstrated use of a CRM system
  • Excellent interpersonal skills that include professional and motivational communication, public speaking, and relationship building
  • Excellent organizational and analytical skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced work environment and manage multiple project deadlines simultaneously
  • Ability to work within a team and independently
  • Ability for confidentiality
  • Significant independent judgment and autonomy regarding work and project completion
  • Must be available to work evenings, nights and weekends for recruitment travel activities throughout the year
  • Proficient understanding of technology and computer systems to include Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams), and other Microsoft applications including presentation and web/video conferencing tools
  • Must be a self-starter with ability to work independently and on a team
  • A valid driver's license with a satisfactory driving record and reliable vehicle

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s degree in Communication, Higher Education, Marketing, or closely related field Admissions Office experience
  • Experience working with underrepresented, first-generation, Pell-eligible, and diverse populations


Alma College is classified as a selective Baccalaureate College: Diverse Fields by the Carnegie Foundation for the Advancement of Teaching. Alma is committed to academic excellence and the development of responsible leaders; our students thrive on challenging academic programs in a supportive, small-college environment emphasizing active, collaborative learning and close student-faculty interaction. Alma is a private Phi Beta Kappa institution located in the center of Michigan’s Lower Peninsula.

Alma College is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to recruiting and retaining a diverse faculty, staff, and student body.

Alma College recognizes that we are all transformed when we celebrate and value the varied identities, backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives in our campus community. We are committed to recognizing and removing barriers to success and providing equitable access to opportunities through education and advocacy. In our increasingly diverse campus and world, we pledge to create a climate where everyone is safe and free to grow intellectually, spiritually, and emotionally.

title: Ag Yard Utility
description:

At Moon Valley Nurseries, you will play a versatile role in supporting various aspects of nursery operations and customer service. Your responsibilities will include performing a range of tasks such as equipment maintenance, yard organization, and customer assistance. title: Quality Supervisor
description:
Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms.

Position Overview

Saronic Technologies is seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Quality Supervisor to join our growing production team. This role is responsible for overseeing inspection activities and leading a team of Quality Inspectors to ensure our autonomous surface vessels meet the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance prior to delivery.

The Quality Supervisor will work closely with engineering, production, and supply chain teams to maintain compliance with design specifications, industry standards, and regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate is shift-flexible, highly organized, and possesses strong technical inspection knowledge along with leadership experience in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities

Inspection & Testing

  • Oversee and guide Quality Inspectors in conducting inspections and tests on components, assemblies, and finished vessels to verify compliance with design specifications, industry standards, and regulatory requirements.

  • Ensure consistent application of inspection procedures across shifts and production areas.

Documentation & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate and detailed records of inspection results, nonconformances, and corrective actions.

  • Prepare inspection reports and communicate findings to engineering and production teams to support timely resolution.

Compliance & Quality Standards

  • Ensure team adherence to internal quality policies, procedures, and applicable industry standards, including DoD-related requirements.

  • Monitor inspection activities and enforce quality protocols across production operations.

Problem Solving & Root Cause Analysis

  • Identify defects or deviations from specifications and lead investigations into root causes.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement corrective and preventive actions.

Continuous Improvement

  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives and support the development and refinement of quality control procedures and best practices.

  • Recommend process improvements that enhance product quality, efficiency, and consistency.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with engineering, production, and suppliers to address quality issues and support the successful delivery of autonomous surface vessels.

Leadership

  • Lead and coordinate inspection activities across shifts while setting the standard for quality performance and accountability.

  • Ensure alignment with company standards, production goals, and quality expectations.

Training & Development

  • Assist with onboarding and training new Quality Inspectors on inspection techniques, documentation processes, and quality standards.

  • Provide ongoing mentorship and guidance to support team development.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in quality inspection, preferably in aerospace, defense, maritime, or advanced manufacturing environments.

  • 1+ years of experience leading or mentoring technical staff.

  • Strong understanding of quality control principles, inspection methodologies, and root cause analysis.

  • Proficiency with inspection tools and equipment (e.g., calipers, micrometers, gauges).

  • Knowledge of industry standards and regulatory requirements, including DoD quality expectations.

  • Excellent problem-solving abilities with strong attention to detail.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.

Physical Demands

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer

  • Occasional standing and walking within the office

  • Manual dexterity to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment

  • Visual acuity to read screens, documents, and reports

  • Occasional reaching, bending, or stooping to access file drawers, cabinets, or office supplies

  • Lifting and carrying items up to 20 pounds occasionally (e.g., office supplies, packages)

Benefits

Medical Insurance: Comprehensive health insurance plans covering a range of services

Saronic pays 100% of the premium for employees and 80% for dependents

Dental and Vision Insurance: Coverage for routine dental check-ups, orthodontics, and vision care

Saronic pays 100% of the premium under the basic plan for employees and 80% for dependents

Time Off: Generous PTO and Holidays

Parental Leave: Paid maternity and paternity leave to support new parents

Competitive Salary: Industry-standard salaries with opportunities for performance-based bonuses

Retirement Plan: 401(k) plan with company match

Stock Options: Equity options to give employees a stake in the company’s success

Life and Disability Insurance: Basic life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage

Pet Insurance: Discounted pet insurance options including 24/7 Telehealth helpline

Additional Perks: Free lunch benefit and unlimited free drinks and snacks in the office

Saronic CCPA Notice for Candidates and California Employees

If this role is based in the United States, it requires access to export-controlled information or items that require “U.S. Person” status. Saronic does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other reason prohibited by law in provision of employment opportunities and benefits.
